name: app.R
content:
# ElectroFast: Shiny app for electrochemical data from CHI, PalmSens, EMF16 and Pine instruments.
# Modules: ECSA of gold (CV in H2SO4), ISE calibration (EMF16, one or more days), ISE
# selectivity (fixed interference and separate solution methods), precision, and the
# Techniques menu: surface area from any CV peak, scan rate, Tafel, DPV/SWV calibration,
# open-circuit potential, chronoamperometry (i-t, steps, multi-potential steps),
# chronopotentiometry (transition time, Sand) and RRDE (collection and faradaic efficiency).
# Run from the project folder: shiny::runApp()

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(shiny))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(bslib))

letters_from = function(txt) {
  x = toupper(trimws(strsplit(txt, "[,; ]+")[[1]]))
  x[nzchar(x)]
}
day_colours = function(days) setNames(rep(cycle_palette("#CC9900"), length.out = length(days)), days)
# numbers as text with 4 significant figures, so tables never round small values such as 1e-05 M to 0.00, and readable headers
round_df = function(d, digits = 4) {
  if (is.null(d)) return(d)   # an empty table (for example QC charts before a history is loaded) stays empty
  d[] = lapply(d, function(v) if (!is.numeric(v)) v else
    vapply(v, function(x) if (is.na(x)) NA_character_ else format(signif(x, digits), scientific = x != 0 && abs(x) < 1e-3), ""))
  names(d) = nice_names(names(d))   # readable headers for display; the data keep their code names
  d
}
std_cols = c("file", "day", "letter", "conc_M", "include", "note")

render_std = function(tbl) {
  DT::renderDT(DT::datatable(tbl()[, std_cols], rownames = FALSE, selection = "none",
                             editable = list(target = "cell", disable = list(columns = c(0, 2, 5))),
                             options = list(pageLength = 50, dom = "t")))
}
apply_edit = function(tbl, info) {
  d = tbl()
  col = std_cols[info$col + 1]
  # typing a concentration includes the standard, so one edit is enough
  if (col == "conc_M") {
    v = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(info$value))
    d$conc_M[info$row] = v
    d$include[info$row] = !is.na(v) && v > 0
    if (!is.na(v)) d$note[info$row] = "concentration entered by hand"
  }
  if (col == "day") d$day[info$row] = trimws(info$value)
  if (col == "include") d$include[info$row] = toupper(trimws(info$value)) %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES")
  tbl(d)
}

ui = page_navbar(
  title = electrofast_brand(), window_title = "ElectroFast",
  id = "main_nav",
  theme = electrofast_theme(),
  header = tags$head(tags$script(src = "session_keeper.js"), tags$link(rel = "icon", type = "image/png", href = "favicon.png")),
  methods_ui(),
  performance_ui(),
  nav_panel("QC charts",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(width = 340,
        fileInput("qc_file", "Load a QC history (CSV)", accept = ".csv"),
        downloadButton("qc_template", "Empty history (CSV)", class = "btn-sm mb-2"),
        actionButton("qc_add_session", "Add this session's results", class = "btn-sm mb-2"),
        helpText("Adds one row per day for each result that is loaded. These are the ISE slope and intercept (ISE calibration tab),",
                 "the background b (background-corrected fit) and the ECSA (ECSA tab)."),
        h6("Or add one value"),
        dateInput("qc_date", "Date", Sys.Date()),
        textInput("qc_quantity", "Quantity", "Check standard X (mV)"),
        numericInput("qc_value", "Value", NA),
        textInput("qc_electrode", "Electrode (optional)", ""),
        actionButton("qc_add_one", "Add", class = "btn-sm mb-2"),
        numericInput("qc_nref", "Reference period: first n sessions of each quantity (blank = all)", NA, min = 2, step = 1),
        helpText("Set the reference period to sessions known to be good. Left blank, every session (any bad ones too) sets the limits."),
        helpText("Limits are the mean and SD of the reference period. The rules (Westgard et al., Clin. Chem. 1981, 27, 493) are as thus.",
                 "1-3s: one point beyond 3 SD. 2-2s: two in a row beyond 2 SD on one side. R-4s: two in a row more than 4 SD apart.",
                 "4-1s: four in a row beyond 1 SD on one side. 10x: ten in a row on one side. One point beyond 2 SD is a warning.",
                 "The checks suggested for a broken rule are prompts, not diagnoses."),
        helpText("Nothing is stored on the server: download the history and load it again next time."),
        downloadButton("qc_download", "Download the history (CSV)")
      ),
      uiOutput("qc_status"),
      plotOutput("qc_plot", height = "560px", fill = FALSE),
      h6("Limits"), tableOutput("qc_limits"),
      h6("Sessions"), tableOutput("qc_table")
    )
  ),
  panel_cell(),
  nav_panel("Report",
    card(
      h5("Analysis report"),
      p("One HTML, PDF or PowerPoint report with every tab that has data loaded, the Techniques tabs included. It holds the settings, plots and tables, and a short summary of each result.",
        "Tabs without data are left out."),
      textInput("rep_title", "Report title", "ElectroFast analysis report"),
      textInput("rep_author", "Prepared by (optional)", ""),
      downloadButton("report_html", "Download report (HTML)"),
      downloadButton("report_pdf", "Download report (PDF)"),
      downloadButton("report_pptx", "Download slides (PowerPoint)"),
      downloadButton("report_bundle", "Download reproducibility bundle (zip)"),
      helpText("The PDF and the slides hold the same results as the HTML report. The slides are 16:9. They start with a title slide, which lists the electrolyte and electrodes typed on the Cell diagram tab, and a slide of main points. One slide per plot follows, with its result underneath, then the tables. The settings and files come last. The HTML report has a contents list and keeps long tables on one page."),
      helpText("Every report records the ElectroFast version, the R version, when it was made and a checksum of each file used. The bundle adds every setting, the package versions, every results table as CSV and a copy of the code. The analysis can then be traced and repeated.")
    )
  ),
  guide_ui(),
  panel_equations(),
  nav_panel("About",
    card(
      h5("What ElectroFast does"),
      p("ElectroFast analyses electrochemical data straight from the files the instruments write. Load the files on a tab,",
        "set the options, and read the results and plots next to them. The Report tab collects every tab with data into one report."),
      p("The Techniques menu has one entry per technique, named as in potentiostat software. Each entry holds the analyses",
        "that technique allows, for example surface area, peaks and kinetics under cyclic voltammetry."),
      p("The Sensor performance menu reports the sensitivity, selectivity, specificity, stability, speed and precision of a",
        "sensor from the results of any technique."),
      p("The Guide tab explains what each tab needs and what it gives. The Equations tab lists every equation and its source."),
      h5("Files"),
      p("ElectroFast reads files from CH Instruments, PalmSens, BioLogic, Gamry, Pine, Axon pCLAMP and Lawson Labs EMF16,",
        "and any other text or CSV file with a header row. Units are read from each file, never assumed."),
      p("The BioLogic and Gamry readers were checked on public test files from the yadg and gamry-parser projects.",
        "BioLogic binary (.mpr) files are not read: export the run from EC-Lab as text (.mpt)."),
      h5("Your data"),
      p("Files are used only while the page is open and are not kept on the server. A copy stays in this browser so that",
        "a page closed by mistake can be restored."),
      h5("Version"),
      p(sprintf("ElectroFast %s (%s). Every report records this version, the R version, the time and a checksum of each file.", electrofast_version, electrofast_version_date))

  nav_item(div(class = "d-flex align-items-center gap-2", style = "padding-top: 0.6rem;",

    selectInput("instrument", NULL, width = "250px",
      c("Auto-detect from the file" = "auto", "CH Instruments (.txt)" = "chi", "PalmSens (.pssession)" = "pssession",
        "BioLogic EC-Lab (.mpt)" = "biologic", "Gamry (.DTA)" = "gamry", "Pine AfterMath (.txt)" = "pine", "Axon pCLAMP (.abf)" = "abf",
        "Metrohm Autolab, other text or CSV" = "text")),
    # each user decides; untick for figures with no added text (for a paper, for example)
    div(style = "padding-left: 0.6rem;", checkboxInput("fig_credit", "Name on figures", TRUE)),
    # off by default, so figures stay as they are unless the user asks for the labels
    div(style = "padding-left: 0.6rem;", checkboxInput("fig_labels", "Label plots", FALSE))))

server = function(input, output, session) {

  # A plot on a hidden tab can report a size of 0, and redrawing it at 0 px stops it with
  # "invalid 'height' argument". Every plot below falls back to a default size instead.
  size_or = function(what, default) function() {
    info = getCurrentOutputInfo()
    v = if (is.function(info[[what]])) info[[what]]() else NULL
    if (is.null(v) || !is.finite(v) || v <= 0) default else v
  }
  renderPlot = function(expr, env = parent.frame()) shiny::renderPlot(substitute(expr), env = env, quoted = TRUE,
                                                                    width = size_or("width", 700), height = size_or("height", 450))

  # Techniques menu (surface area, scan rate, Tafel, DPV/SWV, OCP, CA, CP, RRDE)
  source("app_methods_server.R", local = TRUE)
  source("app_performance_server.R", local = TRUE)

  # ECSA
  ecsa_x = reactive({ req(input$ecsa_file); read_echem(input$ecsa_file$datapath, input$ecsa_file$name, input$instrument) })
  ecsa_geo = electrode_server("ecsa_el")
  ecsa_fit = reactive(ecsa_gold(ecsa_x(), q_ref_uC_cm2 = input$ecsa_qref,
                                geometric_area_cm2 = ecsa_geo()$area_cm2))
  ecsa_plot = reactive(plot_ecsa_cv(ecsa_fit(), ecsa_x(), title = input$ecsa_title, reference = input$ecsa_ref) + watermark())
  output$ecsa_plot = renderPlot(ecsa_plot())
  ecsa_res = reactive({
    r = ecsa_fit()$result
    data.frame(File = input$ecsa_file$name, `Cathodic sweep` = r$segment, `Peak potential (V)` = r$peak_E_V,
               `Baseline window (V)` = sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", r$lower_limit_V, r$upper_limit_V),
               `Q (µC)` = r$Q_uC, `ECSA (cm²)` = r$ECSA_cm2, `Roughness factor` = r$roughness_factor,
               `Charge change from previous cycle (%)` = r$change_last_cycle_pct, Note = r$note %||% "", check.names = FALSE)
  })
  observeEvent(ecsa_fit(), { n = ecsa_fit()$result$note; if (isTRUE(nzchar(n))) showNotification(n, type = "warning", duration = 15, id = "ecsa_inverted") })
  output$ecsa_table = renderTable(ecsa_res(), digits = 4)
  output$ecsa_png = downloadHandler("ecsa_cv.png", function(f) fig_save(f, ecsa_plot(), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300))
  output$ecsa_pdf = downloadHandler("ecsa_cv.pdf", function(f) fig_save(f, ecsa_plot(), width = 7, height = 5, device = echem_pdf))
  output$ecsa_csv = downloadHandler("ecsa_results.csv", function(f) write.csv(ecsa_res(), f, row.names = FALSE))

  # ISE calibration
  cal_std = reactiveVal(NULL)
  # the coding is read from the file names of each new upload; the user can still change it
  # files come only from the user's upload; nothing is bundled with the app
  cal_input = reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(input$cal_files, cal_input(input$cal_files))
  observeEvent(cal_input(), updateRadioButtons(session, "scheme", selected = detect_scheme(cal_input()$name)))
  output$sheet_template = downloadHandler("sample_sheet_template.csv",
    function(f) utils::write.csv(sample_sheet_template(), f, row.names = FALSE))
  cal_sheet = reactive({
    if (is.null(input$cal_sheet)) return(NULL)
    tryCatch(read_sample_sheet(input$cal_sheet$datapath), error = function(e) {
      notify_error(e, duration = 10); NULL })
  })
  observeEvent(list(cal_input(), input$scheme, input$cal_sheet), {
    st = standards_table(req(cal_input()), scheme = input$scheme, sheet = cal_sheet())
    n_unknown = sum(is.na(st$conc_M))
    if (n_unknown) showNotification(sprintf("%d file(s) need a concentration: type it in the conc_M cell of the Standards table, or upload a sample sheet.", n_unknown),
                                    type = "warning", duration = 12)
    cal_std(st)
  })
  observeEvent(input$scheme, {
    if (input$scheme == "protocol") {
      updateTextInput(session, "fit_letters", value = "E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M")
      updateTextInput(session, "cmp_letters", value = "G, H, I, J, K, L, M")
      updateTextInput(session, "chk_letters", value = "I, X, Z")
      # 1e-9 to 1e-4 M on the plateau and 1e-2 to 1e-1 M on the line, as in the July defaults
      updateTextInput(session, "fim_flat", value = "A, B, C, D, E, F, G")
      updateTextInput(session, "fim_nernst", value = "K, L, M")
    } else {
      updateTextInput(session, "fit_letters", value = "E, F, G, H, I")
      updateTextInput(session, "cmp_letters", value = "F, G, H, I")
      updateTextInput(session, "chk_letters", value = "")
      updateTextInput(session, "fim_flat", value = "A, B, C, D, E, F")
      updateTextInput(session, "fim_nernst", value = "H, I")
    }
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  output$cal_std = render_std(reactive(req(cal_std())))
  observeEvent(input$cal_std_cell_edit, apply_edit(cal_std, input$cal_std_cell_edit))
  cal_pts = reactive({
    st = req(cal_std())
    # letter codes choose the fitted standards by letter, the other routes by the concentration range
    st$fit = fit_flags(st, letters_from(input$fit_letters), conc_range = c(input$fit_cfrom %||% 1e-5, input$fit_cto %||% 0.1))
    withProgress(message = "Reading EMF16 files", add_emf(st, input$read_s, input$bgI, input$zA))
  })
  cal_res = reactive(calibrate(cal_pts(), input$xaxis, input$temp, input$zA))
  cal_cmp = reactive({
    L = letters_from(input$cmp_letters)
    if (!length(L)) return(NULL)
    p = cal_pts(); p$fit = p$letter %in% L
    calibrate(p, input$xaxis, input$temp, input$zA)
  })
  cal_bg = reactive(if (isTRUE(input$bg_fit)) fit_background(cal_pts(), input$xaxis, input$temp, input$zA))
  cal_plot = reactive({
    p = cal_pts(); r = req(cal_res())
    x = input$xaxis
    lines = do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(r$per_day)), function(i) {
      d = p[p$day == r$per_day$day[i] & p$fit, ]
      xr = range(d[[x]]) + c(-0.2, 0.2)
      data.frame(day = r$per_day$day[i], x = xr, E_mV = r$per_day$intercept_mV[i] + r$per_day$slope_mV_dec[i] * xr)
    }))
    s = r$summary
    lab = sprintf("Slope %.2f ± %.2f mV/decade (n = %d days)\n%.1f%% of %.2f, R² %.4f to %.4f",
                  s$slope_mean, ifelse(is.na(s$slope_sd), 0, s$slope_sd), s$days, s$pct_nernst, r$S, s$r2_min, s$r2_max)
    bg = cal_bg()
    curves = if (!is.null(bg)) background_curve(bg, range(p[[x]]))
    g0 = ggplot2::ggplot(p, ggplot2::aes(.data[[x]], E_mV, colour = day))
    if (!is.null(curves)) g0 = g0 + ggplot2::geom_line(data = curves, ggplot2::aes(xval, E_mV), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.45)
    g0 +
      ggplot2::geom_line(data = lines, ggplot2::aes(x, E_mV), linewidth = 0.6) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = fit), size = 2.6, stroke = 0.8) +
      ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 15, `FALSE` = 0), labels = c(`TRUE` = "Fitted", `FALSE` = "Not fitted"), name = NULL) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = day_colours(sort(unique(p$day))), name = "Day") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = max(p[[x]]), y = min(p$E_mV), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.4, label = lab) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(p[[x]])), 1)) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = if (x == "neg_log_a") expression("−log "*italic(a)) else expression("−log "*italic(c)),
                    y = "EMF (mV)", subtitle = sprintf("Potential at %g s in each standard, %g °C.
Solid: linear fit over the fitted standards.%s",
                    input$read_s, input$temp, if (!is.null(cal_bg())) " Dashed: background-corrected fit to all standards." else "")) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) + watermark()
  })
  output$cal_plot = renderPlot(cal_plot())
  fmt_summary = function(r) {
    if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    s = r$summary
    data.frame(Days = s$days, `Linear range` = s$range, `Slope (mV/decade)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", s$slope_mean, s$slope_sd),
               `% of Nernstian` = sprintf("%.1f", s$pct_nernst), `R²` = sprintf("%.4f to %.4f", s$r2_min, s$r2_max), check.names = FALSE)
  }
  output$cal_summary = renderTable(fmt_summary(cal_res()))
  output$cal_perday = renderTable(round_df(req(cal_res())$per_day[, c("day", "n", "from_M", "to_M", "slope_mV_dec", "r2", "pct_nernst")]))
  output$cal_cmp = renderTable(fmt_summary(cal_cmp()))
  output$cal_bg = renderTable({
    bg = req(cal_bg()); s = bg$summary
    data.frame(Days = s$days, `Slope (mV/decade)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", s$slope_mean, s$slope_sd),
               `% of Nernstian` = sprintf("%.1f", s$pct_nernst),
               `Background b (M)` = sprintf("%.2g ± %.2g", s$b_bkg_mean, s$b_bkg_sd),
               `R²` = sprintf("%.4f to %.4f", s$r2_min, s$r2_max), check.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$cal_bg_perday = renderTable(round_df(req(cal_bg())$per_day))
  output$cal_bg_csv = downloadHandler("ise_background_fit.csv", function(f) write.csv(req(cal_bg())$per_day, f, row.names = FALSE))
  output$cal_steps = renderTable(round_df(steps_table(cal_pts(), input$xaxis, input$temp, input$zA)))
  observe(updateSelectInput(session, "trace_day", choices = sort(unique(req(cal_std())$day))))
  output$trace_plot = renderPlot({
    st = req(cal_std()); st = st[st$include & st$day == req(input$trace_day), ]
    tr = do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(st)), function(i) cbind(label = st$letter[i], emf_trace(st$datapath[i]))))
    ggplot2::ggplot(tr, ggplot2::aes(time_s, emf_mV, colour = label)) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = input$read_s, linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(rep(cycle_palette("#CC9900"), length.out = nrow(st)), st$letter), name = "Standard") +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "EMF (mV)", subtitle = "Dashed line: reading time") +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) + watermark()
  })
  output$cal_csv = downloadHandler("ise_calibration.csv", function(f) {
    r = cal_res(); p = cal_pts()
    out = merge(p[, c("day", "letter", "conc_M", "neg_log_c", "neg_log_a", "E_mV", "fit")], r$per_day, by = "day", all.x = TRUE)
    write.csv(out, f, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$cal_png = downloadHandler("ise_calibration.png", function(f) fig_save(f, cal_plot(), width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300))
  output$cal_pdf = downloadHandler("ise_calibration.pdf", function(f) fig_save(f, cal_plot(), width = 7.5, height = 5, device = echem_pdf))

  # Reading time
  rt_settle = reactive(withProgress(message = "Checking settling", settling_table(cal_pts(), input$rt_drift)))
  # possible causes: the signs measured on this tab, day by day, with the user's cut-offs
  dx = reactive({
    th = list(slope_lo = input$dx_slope_lo %||% 90, slope_hi = 200 - (input$dx_slope_lo %||% 90), low_end = input$dx_low %||% 0.6,
              background = input$dx_bg %||% 3, drift_mV = input$dx_drift %||% 5, r2 = input$dx_r2 %||% 0.98, unsettled = input$dx_unsettled %||% 0.2)
    diagnose_ise(cal_pts(), req(cal_res()), safely(cal_bg), safely(rt_settle), input$xaxis, input$read_s, th) })
  output$dx_signs = renderTable(round_df(dx()$signs))
  output$dx_causes = renderTable(dx()$causes)
  rt_slopes = reactive(withProgress(message = "Fitting at each reading time", slope_by_time(cal_pts(), x = input$xaxis, T_C = input$temp, z = input$zA, flag_mV = input$rt_flag)))
  output$rt_suggest = renderTable({
    s = req(suggest_read_time(rt_settle(), input$rt_share))
    data.frame(`Suggested reading time (s)` = ifelse(is.na(s$read_s), "none: not enough standards settled", as.character(s$read_s)),
               `Share settled by then` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * s$share_settled), `Fitted standards` = s$fitted_standards,
               `Never settled` = s$never_settled, check.names = FALSE)
  })
  rt_plot_obj = reactive({
    r = req(rt_slopes())
    S = nernst_S(input$temp, input$zA)
    ggplot2::ggplot(r$long, ggplot2::aes(read_s, slope_mV_dec, colour = day)) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = c(S, -S), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = input$read_s, linetype = "dotted") +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.4) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = day_colours(sort(unique(r$long$day))), name = "Day") +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Reading time (s)", y = "Slope (mV/decade)", subtitle = "Dashed: Nernstian slope. Dotted: the reading time in use.") +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) + watermark()
  })
  output$rt_plot = renderPlot(rt_plot_obj())
  output$rt_spread = renderTable(round_df(req(rt_slopes())$spread))
  output$rt_settle = renderTable(round_df(req(rt_settle())))
  output$rt_csv = downloadHandler("reading_time.csv", function(f) {
    st = rt_settle(); sl = rt_slopes()$long
    write.csv(merge(st, sl, by = "day", all = TRUE), f, row.names = FALSE)
  })

  # Precision
  # readings at the check concentration whose letter is not listed are left out of the
  # repeatability estimate only; the calibration itself is unchanged
  prec_pts = reactive({
    p = cal_pts(); L = letters_from(if (is.null(input$chk_letters)) "" else input$chk_letters)
    if (length(L)) p = p[!(abs(p$conc_M - input$chk_conc) < 1e-12 & !is.na(p$letter) & !p$letter %in% L), ]
    p
  })
  prec_chk = reactive(precision_check(prec_pts(), input$chk_conc, input$temp, input$zA))
  prec_cal = reactive(precision_calibration(cal_pts(), input$xaxis))
  output$prec_notes = renderUI({
    n = c(prec_chk()$notes, prec_cal()$notes)
    if (length(n)) div(class = "alert alert-warning", HTML(paste(htmltools::htmlEscape(n), collapse = "<br>")))
  })
  output$prec_metrics = renderTable({
    m = req(prec_chk()$metrics)
    data.frame(Metric = m$metric, `SD (mV)` = sprintf("%.2f", m$SD_mV),
               `Equivalent concentration error (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", m$conc_error_pct), check.names = FALSE)
  })
  prec_blup_obj = reactive({
    b = req(prec_chk()$blup)
    ggplot2::ggplot(b, ggplot2::aes(day, effect_mV)) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
      ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#1A6FDF") +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Day", y = "Day effect (mV)", subtitle = "Estimated offset of each day from the overall mean (BLUP, 95% interval)") +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) + watermark()
  })
  output$prec_blup = renderPlot(prec_blup_obj())
  output$prec_cal = renderTable({
    t = req(prec_cal()$table)
    data.frame(Days = t$days, `Pooled slope (mV/decade)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f (SE)", t$pooled_slope, t$pooled_slope_se),
               `Between-day SD of baseline (mV)` = sprintf("%.2f", t$between_day_baseline_sd),
               `Between-day SD of slope (mV/decade)` = ifelse(is.na(t$between_day_slope_sd), "not estimable", sprintf("%.2f", t$between_day_slope_sd)),
               check.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$prec_csv = downloadHandler("precision.csv", function(f) {
    m = prec_chk()$metrics; m$notes = paste(c(prec_chk()$notes, prec_cal()$notes), collapse = " | ")
    write.csv(m, f, row.names = FALSE)
  })

  # Fixed interference method
  fim_std = reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(list(input$fim_files, input$scheme), fim_std(standards_table(req(input$fim_files), scheme = if (isTRUE(input$scheme %in% c("july", "protocol"))) input$scheme else detect_scheme(input$fim_files$name))))
  output$fim_std = render_std(reactive(req(fim_std())))
  observeEvent(input$fim_std_cell_edit, apply_edit(fim_std, input$fim_std_cell_edit))
  fim_pts = reactive({
    st = req(fim_std()); st$fit = st$include
    withProgress(message = "Reading EMF16 files", add_emf(st, input$read_s, background_I = input$fim_cB, z = input$zA))
  })
  fim_res = reactive(fim(fim_pts(), letters_from(input$fim_flat), letters_from(input$fim_nernst),
                         input$fim_cB, input$zA, input$fim_zB, input$temp))
  output$fim_summary = renderTable({
    s = req(fim_res())$summary
    data.frame(Days = s$days, K = sprintf("%.3g ± %.2g", s$K_mean, s$K_sd),
               `log K` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", s$lgK_mean, s$lgK_sd), check.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$fim_perday = renderTable(round_df(req(fim_res())$per_day))
  fim_plot_obj = reactive({
    p = fim_pts(); r = req(fim_res())
    lines = do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(r$per_day)), function(i) {
      d = p[p$day == r$per_day$day[i] & p$letter %in% letters_from(input$fim_nernst), ]
      m = lm(E_mV ~ neg_log_a, d)
      xn = c(min(p$neg_log_a) - 0.1, max(d$neg_log_a) + 2)
      rbind(data.frame(day = r$per_day$day[i], part = "flat", x = c(min(d$neg_log_a) + 0.5, max(p$neg_log_a) + 0.2), E_mV = r$per_day$flat_mV[i]),
            data.frame(day = r$per_day$day[i], part = "line", x = xn, E_mV = coef(m)[1] + coef(m)[2] * xn))
    }))
    ggplot2::ggplot(p, ggplot2::aes(neg_log_a, E_mV, colour = day)) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(data = lines, ggplot2::aes(x, E_mV, group = interaction(day, part)), linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.6) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = day_colours(sort(unique(p$day))), name = "Day") +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = expression("−log "*italic(a)*" (primary ion)"), y = "EMF (mV)",
                    subtitle = sprintf("Interferent fixed at %g M, potential read at %g s", input$fim_cB, input$read_s)) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) + watermark()
  })
  output$fim_plot = renderPlot(fim_plot_obj())
  output$fim_csv = downloadHandler("fim_results.csv", function(f) write.csv(req(fim_res())$per_day, f, row.names = FALSE))

  # Separate solution method
  ssm_std = reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(list(input$ssm_files, input$scheme), ssm_std(standards_table(req(input$ssm_files), scheme = if (isTRUE(input$scheme %in% c("july", "protocol"))) input$scheme else detect_scheme(input$ssm_files$name))))
  output$ssm_std = render_std(reactive(req(ssm_std())))
  observeEvent(input$ssm_std_cell_edit, apply_edit(ssm_std, input$ssm_std_cell_edit))
  ssm_res = reactive({
    b = req(ssm_std()); b$fit = b$include
    ib = withProgress(message = "Reading EMF16 files", add_emf(b, input$read_s, input$bgI, input$ssm_zB))
    concs = as.numeric(strsplit(input$ssm_concs, "[,; ]+")[[1]])
    ssm(cal_pts(), ib, concs[!is.na(concs)], input$zA, input$ssm_zB, input$temp)
  })
  output$ssm_table = renderTable(round_df(req(ssm_res())))
  output$ssm_csv = downloadHandler("ssm_results.csv", function(f) write.csv(req(ssm_res()), f, row.names = FALSE))

  # ECSA tab: gold is measured here; other metals and carbon are pointed to the tab with the right method
  ecsa_metal = list(pt = c("pt_h", "Platinum: hydrogen desorption (210 µC/cm²) is the usual method. Oxide reduction (420) or CO stripping (420) also work."),
                    pd = c("pd_ox424", "Palladium: PdO reduction, 424 µC/cm² (hydrogen is absorbed into Pd, so the hydrogen region is not used)."),
                    rh = c("rh_h", "Rhodium: hydrogen desorption (221 µC/cm²) or oxide reduction (442)."),
                    ir = c("ir_h", "Iridium: hydrogen desorption (218 µC/cm²)."))
  output$ecsa_metal_help = renderUI(helpText(ecsa_metal[[req(input$ecsa_material)]][2]))
  # choosing a metal sets the window method below to that metal's usual reference
  observeEvent(input$ecsa_material, if (input$ecsa_material %in% names(ecsa_metal))
    updateSelectInput(session, "sa_preset", selected = ecsa_metal[[input$ecsa_material]][1]))
  observeEvent(input$ecsa_go_cv, bslib::nav_select("cv_sub", "Peaks and kinetics"))
  observeEvent(input$ecsa_go_ca, bslib::nav_select("main_nav", "Chronoamperometry"))
  observeEvent(input$ecsa_go_dl, bslib::nav_select("cv_sub", "Double-layer capacitance"))

  # QC charts: the history is kept in this session and downloaded by the user
  qc_hist = reactiveVal(qc_template())
  observeEvent(input$qc_file, qc_hist(tryCatch(qc_read(input$qc_file$datapath), error = function(e) {
    notify_error(e); qc_hist() })))
  as_qc_date = function(day) { d = as.Date(day, tryFormats = c("%m-%d-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y"), optional = TRUE)
    ifelse(is.na(d), format(Sys.Date()), format(d)) }
  observeEvent(input$qc_add_session, {
    rows = list()
    r = safely(cal_res)
    if (!is.null(r)) rows = c(rows, list(
      data.frame(date = as_qc_date(r$per_day$day), quantity = "ISE slope (mV/decade)", value = r$per_day$slope_mV_dec, unit = "mV/decade", electrode = "", note = "ISE calibration tab"),
      data.frame(date = as_qc_date(r$per_day$day), quantity = "ISE intercept (mV)", value = r$per_day$intercept_mV, unit = "mV", electrode = "", note = "ISE calibration tab")))
    b = safely(cal_bg)
    if (!is.null(b)) rows = c(rows, list(data.frame(date = as_qc_date(b$per_day$day), quantity = "ISE background b (M)", value = b$per_day$b_bkg_M, unit = "M", electrode = "", note = "background-corrected fit")))
    e = safely(ecsa_res)
    if (!is.null(e)) rows = c(rows, list(data.frame(date = format(Sys.Date()), quantity = "ECSA (cm²)", value = e[["ECSA (cm²)"]], unit = "cm²", electrode = "", note = "ECSA tab")))
    if (!length(rows)) { showNotification("No results loaded yet: load files on the ISE calibration or ECSA tab first.", type = "warning"); return() }
    qc_hist(rbind(qc_hist(), do.call(rbind, rows)))
  })
  observeEvent(input$qc_add_one, {
    req(is.finite(input$qc_value), nzchar(input$qc_quantity))
    qc_hist(rbind(qc_hist(), data.frame(date = format(input$qc_date), quantity = input$qc_quantity, value = input$qc_value, unit = "",
                                        electrode = input$qc_electrode, note = "entered by hand")))
  })
  qc_nref = reactive(if (is.null(input$qc_nref) || is.na(input$qc_nref)) NA else input$qc_nref)
  qc_tab = reactive({ h = qc_hist(); validate(need(nrow(h) > 0, "Load a history, add this session's results, or add a value.")); qc_table(h, qc_nref()) })
  output$qc_status = renderUI({ t = qc_tab(); k = sum(grepl("1-3s|2-2s|R-4s|4-1s|10x", t$rule))
    p(sprintf("%d sessions, %d quantities, %d with a broken rule, %d warnings.", nrow(t), length(unique(t$quantity)), k, sum(grepl("warning", t$rule)))) })
  qc_plot_obj = reactive({ qc_tab(); qc_plot(qc_hist(), qc_nref()) + g_theme() })
  output$qc_plot = renderPlot(qc_plot_obj())
  output$qc_limits = renderTable(round_df(qc_limits(qc_hist(), qc_nref())))
  output$qc_table = renderTable(round_df(qc_tab()[, c("date", "quantity", "value", "z", "rule", "check", "electrode", "note")]))
  output$qc_template = downloadHandler("electrofast_qc_history_template.csv", function(f) write.csv(qc_template(), f, row.names = FALSE))
  output$qc_download = downloadHandler(function() sprintf("electrofast_qc_history_%s.csv", format(Sys.Date())),
                                       function(f) write.csv(qc_hist(), f, row.names = FALSE))

  # Cell diagram: drawn only from the entries on the Cell diagram tab
  cd_spec = reactive(list(layout = input$cd_layout, mode = input$cd_mode, we_kind = input$cd_we_kind, we = input$cd_we, re_kind = input$cd_re_kind, re = input$cd_re,
    ce_kind = input$cd_ce_kind, ce = input$cd_ce, electrolyte = input$cd_electrolyte, analyte = input$cd_analyte, analyte_ch = input$cd_analyte_ch, a_kind = input$cd_a_kind, a = input$cd_a,
    b_kind = input$cd_b_kind, b = input$cd_b, sol_a = input$cd_sol_a, sol_b = input$cd_sol_b, separator = input$cd_sep,
    rotation = input$cd_rot, purge = input$cd_purge, gas = input$cd_gas, stir = input$cd_stir, instrument = input$cd_instr,
    title = input$cd_title, subscripts = input$cd_sub, labels = input$cd_labels, style = input$cd_style, particles = input$cd_particles))
  cd_out = reactive(cell_diagram(cd_spec()))
  output$cd_plot = renderPlot(cd_out()$plot)
  cd_save = function(dev) function(f) fig_save(f, cd_out()$plot, width = 10, height = 5.6, dpi = 300, device = dev)
  output$cd_png = downloadHandler("cell_diagram.png", cd_save("png"))
  output$cd_pdf = downloadHandler("cell_diagram.pdf", cd_save(echem_pdf))
  # svglite named here, not "svg": ggsave needs it for SVG, and the deploy and desktop builds find packages by name
  output$cd_svg = downloadHandler("cell_diagram.svg", cd_save(svglite::svglite))
  output$cd_has_photo = reactive(!is.null(input$cd_photo)); outputOptions(output, "cd_has_photo", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
  output$cd_photo_img = renderImage({ p = req(input$cd_photo)
    list(src = p$datapath, contentType = p$type, style = "max-width:100%; height:auto;", alt = "Photo of the cell") }, deleteFile = FALSE)

  # Report: each part is collected only if its tab has data. A tab without data stops at req(),
  # which is caught here so that part is simply left out.
  safely = function(f) tryCatch(f(), error = function(e) NULL)
  report_parts = function() list(
    # the ISE settings are listed only when ISE files were loaded, so a report on other data does not show them
    settings = c(if (!is.null(input$cal_files) || !is.null(input$cal_sheet)) list(`Reading time (s)` = input$read_s, `Temperature (°C)` = input$temp, `Primary ion charge` = input$zA,
                    `Background ionic strength (M)` = input$bgI, `x-axis` = input$xaxis, `Concentrations from` = if (!is.null(input$cal_sheet)) "Sample sheet" else unname(scheme_labels[input$scheme %||% "names"]),
                    `Standards in the fit` = if (isTRUE(input$scheme %in% c("july", "protocol"))) input$fit_letters else sprintf("%g to %g M", input$fit_cfrom %||% 1e-5, input$fit_cto %||% 0.1),
                    `Second range` = if (isTRUE(input$scheme %in% c("july", "protocol"))) input$cmp_letters else ""),
                 as.list(provenance_lines(input_files(reactiveValuesToList(input))))),
    ecsa = safely(function() list(table = ecsa_res(), plot = ecsa_plot())),
    cal = safely(function() list(std = cal_std(), res = req(cal_res()), cmp = cal_cmp(), bg = cal_bg(), plot = cal_plot(), dx = safely(function() dx()$causes),
                                 steps = steps_table(cal_pts(), input$xaxis, input$temp, input$zA))),
    rt = safely(function() list(slopes = req(rt_slopes()), suggest = suggest_read_time(rt_settle(), input$rt_share), plot = rt_plot_obj())),
    prec = safely(function() list(chk = prec_chk(), cal = prec_cal(), notes = c(prec_chk()$notes, prec_cal()$notes),
                                  plot = safely(prec_blup_obj))),
    fim = safely(function() list(res = req(fim_res()), plot = fim_plot_obj(), cB = input$fim_cB)),
    ssm = safely(function() req(ssm_res())),
    # the cell diagram leads the technique sections when the user ticked "Add the diagram to the report"
    techniques = c(if (isTRUE(input$cd_report)) list(list(title = "Cell", text = cd_out()$key$Part, plots = list(`Cell diagram` = cd_out()$plot), tables = list())),
                   technique_parts(), performance_parts(), Filter(Negate(is.null), list(safely(function() { t = qc_tab()
      list(title = "QC charts", text = sprintf("%d sessions, %d with a broken Westgard rule.", nrow(t), sum(grepl("1-3s|2-2s|R-4s|4-1s|10x", t$rule))),
           plots = list(`Control charts` = qc_plot_obj()),
           tables = list(Limits = round_df(qc_limits(qc_hist(), qc_nref())), Sessions = round_df(t[, c("date", "quantity", "value", "z", "rule", "check")]))) })))))
  # The same parts as slide sections (ISE, ECSA, reading time, precision, selectivity), followed by the technique tabs
  pptx_sections = function(P) Filter(Negate(is.null), c(list(
    if (!is.null(P$ecsa)) list(title = "ECSA (gold)", text = sprintf("ECSA %.4f cm², charge %.2f µC, roughness factor %.2f.", P$ecsa$table[["ECSA (cm²)"]], P$ecsa$table[["Q (µC)"]], P$ecsa$table[["Roughness factor"]]),
                               plots = list(Voltammogram = P$ecsa$plot), tables = list(Results = round_df(P$ecsa$table))),
    if (!is.null(P$cal)) { s = P$cal$res$summary
      list(title = "ISE calibration", text = c(sprintf("Slope %s mV/decade over %s, %.1f%% of Nernstian, %d day(s). R² %.4f to %.4f.", if (is.na(s$slope_sd)) sprintf("%.2f", s$slope_mean) else sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", s$slope_mean, s$slope_sd), s$range, s$pct_nernst, s$days, s$r2_min, s$r2_max),
                                               if (!is.null(P$cal$bg)) sprintf("Background-corrected fit: %.2f mV/decade, background %.2g M.", P$cal$bg$summary$slope_mean, P$cal$bg$summary$b_bkg_mean)),
           plots = list(Calibration = P$cal$plot), tables = Filter(Negate(is.null), list(`Each day` = round_df(P$cal$res$per_day[, c("day", "n", "slope_mV_dec", "intercept_mV", "r2", "pct_nernst")]), Steps = round_df(P$cal$steps), `Possible causes` = P$cal$dx))) },
    if (!is.null(P$rt)) list(title = "Reading time", text = NULL, plots = list(`Slope by reading time` = P$rt$plot), tables = list(Spread = round_df(P$rt$slopes$spread))),
    if (!is.null(P$prec)) list(title = "Precision", text = P$prec$notes, plots = Filter(Negate(is.null), list(`Day effects` = P$prec$plot)), tables = Filter(Negate(is.null), list(`Check standard` = P$prec$chk$metrics, `Calibration across days` = P$prec$cal$table))),
    if (!is.null(P$fim)) list(title = "Selectivity: fixed interference", text = sprintf("log K = %.2f (interferent %g M).", P$fim$res$summary$lgK_mean, P$fim$cB), plots = list(FIM = P$fim$plot), tables = list(`Each day` = round_df(P$fim$res$per_day))),
    if (!is.null(P$ssm)) list(title = "Selectivity: separate solution", text = NULL, plots = list(), tables = list(Results = round_df(P$ssm)))),
    P$techniques))
  output$report_pptx = downloadHandler(
    filename = function() sprintf("ElectroFast_slides_%s.pptx", format(Sys.Date())),
    content = function(file) withProgress(message = "Building the slides", {
      # the title slide lists the cell only from what was typed on the Cell diagram tab
      det = c(Electrolyte = input$cd_electrolyte %||% "", `Working electrode` = input$cd_we %||% "", `Reference electrode` = input$cd_re %||% "",
              `Counter electrode` = input$cd_ce %||% "")
      P = report_parts(); build_pptx(file, input$rep_title, input$rep_author %||% "", P$settings, pptx_sections(P), det) }))
  output$report_pdf = downloadHandler(
    filename = function() sprintf("ElectroFast_report_%s.pdf", format(Sys.Date())),
    content = function(file) withProgress(message = "Building the PDF", {
      P = report_parts(); build_pdf(file, input$rep_title, input$rep_author %||% "", P$settings, pptx_sections(P)) }))
  output$report_bundle = downloadHandler(
    filename = function() sprintf("ElectroFast_bundle_%s.zip", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d_%H%M")),
    content = function(file) withProgress(message = "Building the bundle", {
      P = report_parts(); build_bundle(file, reactiveValuesToList(input), pptx_sections(P)) }))
  output$report_html = downloadHandler(
    filename = function() sprintf("ElectroFast_report_%s.html", format(Sys.Date())),
    content = function(file) {
      # Pandoc is missing in the browser version (Shinylive): build the same report directly in R there
      if (!rmarkdown::pandoc_available()) return(withProgress(message = "Building the report", {
        P = report_parts(); build_html(file, input$rep_title, input$rep_author %||% "", P$settings, pptx_sections(P)) }))
      tmp = file.path(tempdir(), "electrofast_report.Rmd")
      file.copy("report/electrofast_report.Rmd", tmp, overwrite = TRUE)
      withProgress(message = "Building the report", {
        parts = report_parts()
        rmarkdown::render(tmp, output_file = file, quiet = TRUE, envir = new.env(parent = globalenv()),
                          params = list(parts = parts, title = input$rep_title, author = input$rep_author))
      })
    })
}

name: R/_disable_autoload.R
content: # Its presence stops Shiny from sourcing R/ on its own: app.R sources these files once, in order.

name: R/activity.R
content:
# Single-ion activity coefficients from the Davies equation,
#   log10(gamma) = -A z^2 ( sqrt(I) / (1 + sqrt(I)) - 0.3 I ),
# with A = 0.508 at 25 C (aqion.de, "Activity Coefficients (Activity Models)",
# which gives the equation's validity as I <= 0.5 M). For standards of a 1:1 salt
# such as LiCl or LiClO4 in water with no background electrolyte (the Li+
# standards are LiClO4 in water, nothing added), the ionic strength equals
# the salt concentration.

davies_gamma = function(I, z = 1, A = 0.508) {
  10^(-A * z^2 * (sqrt(I) / (1 + sqrt(I)) - 0.3 * I))
}

name: R/app_core.R
content:
# Calculation layer for the Shiny app: works on uploaded files (temporary path
# plus original name), so it does not depend on the project's folder layout.
# Reports only the metrics common in electroanalytical journals: slope (mean +/-
# SD over days), R2, linear range, % of Nernstian, selectivity coefficients.

source("R/read_emf16_grf.R")
source("R/activity.R")

nernst_S = function(T_C = 25, z = 1) log(10) * 8.314462618 * (T_C + 273.15) / (96485.33212 * abs(z)) * 1000

# File name -> day and standard letter. Handles "7-4-2026_8.9.34 A.txt", doubled
# letters ("AA"), sodium-series names ("AN"), a repeat marked "C MAIN", and a
# missing space ("17.41.47C.txt").
parse_emf_name = function(name) {
  stem = sub("\\.txt$", "", name, ignore.case = TRUE)
  main = grepl("MAIN$", stem)
  stem = sub("\\s*MAIN$", "", stem)
  # A letter code is read only from EMF16-style names ("9-29-2026_17.13.17 A"), so an
  # arbitrary name such as "LiCl 1mM" is not mistaken for code "M"
  emf_style = grepl("^[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{1,2}\\.[0-9]{1,2}\\.[0-9]{1,2}\\s*[A-Za-z]+$", stem)
  code = if (emf_style) toupper(regmatches(stem, regexpr("[A-Za-z]+$", stem))) else character()
  if (!length(code)) code = NA_character_
  day = regmatches(name, regexpr("^[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]{4}", name))
  if (!length(day)) day = "run"
  data.frame(file = name, day = day, code = code, letter = substr(code, 1, 1), main = main)
}

# Standard codes and their default concentrations. "july": the July-August runs,
# A to I = 1e-9 to 1e-1 M in decade steps. "protocol": the five-day protocol
# (2026-09-28), A to O with mid-decade points up to 0.5 M, and X, Y, Z = the 1e-3 M
# check standard read at the start, middle and end of each day.
code_schemes = list(
  july = setNames(10^(-9:-1), LETTERS[1:9]),
  protocol = c(A = 1e-9, B = 1e-8, C = 1e-7, D = 1e-6, E = 1e-5, F = 3e-5, G = 1e-4, H = 3e-4,
               I = 1e-3, J = 3e-3, K = 1e-2, L = 3e-2, M = 1e-1, N = 3e-1, O = 5e-1,
               X = 1e-3, Y = 1e-3, Z = 1e-3)
)

# Concentration written in a file name, in mol/L: "1 mM", "0.1M", "5 uM" or "5 µM", "1e-3 M" or "1e-3", "10-3 M" or
# "10^-3 M". A unit is needed for plain numbers, so a date or a time in the name is not read as a concentration.
# NA when the name holds no concentration or two different ones.
conc_from_name = function(name) {
  s = sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", name)
  unit = c(m = 1, mm = 1e-3, um = 1e-6, "\u00b5m" = 1e-6, nm = 1e-9, pm = 1e-12)
  v = numeric(0)
  m1 = regmatches(s, gregexpr("(?<![0-9.eE+-])[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?\\s*(mM|uM|\u00b5M|nM|pM|M)(?![A-Za-z])", s, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  for (x in m1) { u = tolower(sub("^[0-9.]+\\s*", "", x)); v = c(v, as.numeric(sub("\\s*[A-Za-z\u00b5]+$", "", x)) * unit[[u]]) }
  m2 = regmatches(s, gregexpr("(?<![0-9.])[0-9.]+[eE]-[0-9]+(\\s*M(?![A-Za-z]))?", s, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  v = c(v, as.numeric(sub("\\s*M$", "", m2)))
  m3 = regmatches(s, gregexpr("(?<![0-9])10\\^?-([0-9]{1,2})\\s*M(?![A-Za-z])", s, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  v = c(v, 10^-as.numeric(sub("^10\\^?-([0-9]{1,2}).*$", "\\1", m3)))
  v = unique(signif(v, 10))
  if (length(v) == 1) v else NA_real_
}

# Where concentrations come from when there is no sample sheet. EMF16-style names with letter codes keep their
# coding (letters J to O, or the X, Y, Z check standard, occur only in the five-day protocol); otherwise the
# concentration written in each name; otherwise a decade series in recording order, as a suggestion to check.
detect_scheme = function(names) {
  L = do.call(rbind, lapply(names, parse_emf_name))$letter
  if (any(!is.na(L))) return(if (any(L %in% c(LETTERS[10:15], "X", "Y", "Z"))) "protocol" else "july")
  if (all(!is.na(vapply(names, conc_from_name, 0)))) "names" else "order"
}
scheme_labels = c(names = "Concentration written in the file name", order = "Decade series in recording order (suggested)",
                  july = "Letter codes A to I", protocol = "Letter codes A to O with X, Y, Z check standards")

# Start time recorded inside an EMF16 file ("Started: 9/29/2026, 5:13:16 PM"), for the recording order
emf_start_time = function(path) {
  x = tryCatch(readLines(path, n = 40, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())
  s = grep("^\\s*Started:", x, value = TRUE)
  if (!length(s)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(as.POSIXct(trimws(sub("^\\s*Started:\\s*", "", s[1])), format = "%m/%d/%Y, %I:%M:%S %p", tz = "UTC"))
}

# Day recorded inside an EMF16 file ("Started: 9/29/2026, 5:13:16 PM"), written as
# m-d-yyyy like the file-name date, so the day does not depend on the file name
emf_start_day = function(path) {
  x = tryCatch(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())
  s = grep("^\\s*Started:", x, value = TRUE)
  d = if (length(s)) regmatches(s[1], regexpr("[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}", s[1])) else character()
  if (length(d)) gsub("/", "-", d) else NA_character_
}

truthy = function(v) toupper(trimws(as.character(v))) %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES", "Y")

# Optional sample sheet (CSV): one row per file, with at least the file name and its
# concentration, so files can be named anything. Optional columns: day, include, fit.
sample_sheet_template = function() {
  data.frame(file = c("9-29-2026_17.13.17 A.txt", "my standard 1mM.txt"), conc_M = c(1e-9, 1e-3),
             day = c("", "10-01-2026"), include = c("", ""), fit = c("", ""))
}
read_sample_sheet = function(path) {
  s = utils::read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE, colClasses = "character")
  names(s) = gsub("[^a-z_]", "", tolower(names(s)))
  names(s)[names(s) %in% c("conc", "concentration", "concm", "concentrationm")] = "conc_m"
  if (!all(c("file", "conc_m") %in% names(s)))
    stop("The sample sheet needs the columns 'file' and 'conc_M' (download the template to see the layout).")
  s
}

# Which standards enter the fit: by letter when the file has a code, otherwise by
# concentration (default 1e-5 to 1e-1 M, the range used so far); a 'fit' column in
# the sample sheet overrides both.
fit_flags = function(st, fit_letters, conc_range = c(1e-5, 1e-1)) {
  f = ifelse(!is.na(st$letter), st$letter %in% fit_letters,
             !is.na(st$conc_M) & st$conc_M >= conc_range[1] * 0.999 & st$conc_M <= conc_range[2] * 1.001)
  if (!is.null(st$fit_sheet)) f = ifelse(is.na(st$fit_sheet), f, st$fit_sheet)
  st$include & f
}

# Standards table for uploaded files. Concentration comes from the sample sheet when
# one is given, otherwise from the letter code; the day from the sheet, otherwise from
# inside the file, otherwise from the file name. Anything still unknown is listed with
# a note, never silently dropped. A repeat marked MAIN replaces the earlier reading.
standards_table = function(files, fit_letters = c("E", "F", "G", "H", "I"), scheme = "july", sheet = NULL) {
  st = do.call(rbind, lapply(files$name, parse_emf_name))
  st$datapath = files$datapath
  inside = vapply(as.character(files$datapath), function(p) if (is.na(p)) NA_character_ else emf_start_day(p), "")
  st$day = ifelse(!is.na(inside), inside, st$day)
  suggested = rep(FALSE, nrow(st))
  if (scheme %in% names(code_schemes)) st$conc_M = unname(code_schemes[[scheme]][st$letter]) else {
    # no letter coding: the concentration written in each name, then (route "order") a decade series from 1e-9 M
    # upward in recording order within each day, marked as a suggestion
    st$letter = NA_character_
    st$conc_M = vapply(st$file, conc_from_name, 0, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    if (scheme == "order") {
      tt = vapply(as.character(files$datapath), function(p) if (is.na(p)) NA_real_ else emf_start_time(p), 0)
      ord = ifelse(is.na(tt), seq_len(nrow(st)), tt)
      for (d in unique(st$day)) { k = which(st$day == d & is.na(st$conc_M)); k = k[order(ord[k])]
        n = min(length(k), 9); if (n) { st$conc_M[k[1:n]] = 10^(-9 + seq_len(n) - 1); suggested[k[1:n]] = TRUE } }
    }
  }
  st$fit_sheet = NA
  inc_sheet = rep(NA, nrow(st))
  in_sheet = rep(NA, nrow(st))
  if (!is.null(sheet)) {
    key = function(x) tolower(sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", basename(trimws(x))))
    m = match(key(st$file), key(sheet$file))
    in_sheet = !is.na(m)
    conc = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sheet$conc_m))[m]
    st$conc_M = ifelse(in_sheet & !is.na(conc), conc, st$conc_M)
    if ("day" %in% names(sheet)) { d = sheet$day[m]; use = in_sheet & !is.na(d) & nzchar(d); st$day[use] = d[use] }
    if ("include" %in% names(sheet)) { v = sheet$include[m]; use = in_sheet & !is.na(v) & nzchar(v); inc_sheet[use] = truthy(v[use]) }
    if ("fit" %in% names(sheet)) { v = sheet$fit[m]; use = in_sheet & !is.na(v) & nzchar(v); st$fit_sheet[use] = truthy(v[use]) }
  }
  # a file with no date anywhere joins the day of the other files when they share one;
  # otherwise it is flagged for the user to type the day
  no_day = st$day == "run"
  known = unique(st$day[!no_day])
  if (any(no_day) && length(known) == 1) st$day[no_day] = known
  key = paste(st$day, ifelse(is.na(st$letter), st$file, st$letter))
  dup = duplicated(key) | duplicated(key, fromLast = TRUE)
  st$include = !is.na(st$conc_M) & !(dup & !st$main & ave(st$main, key, FUN = any))
  st$include = ifelse(is.na(inc_sheet), st$include, inc_sheet & !is.na(st$conc_M))
  st$fit = fit_flags(st, fit_letters)
  st$note = ifelse(dup & !st$include, "repeat replaced by MAIN", ifelse(dup & st$main, "MAIN reading used", ifelse(dup, "duplicate standard: check", "")))
  st$note = ifelse(!is.na(in_sheet) & !in_sheet, "not in the sample sheet", st$note)
  st$note = ifelse(no_day & length(known) == 1, "no date in the file: day taken from the other files", st$note)
  st$note = ifelse(st$day == "run", "day unknown: type it in the day cell", st$note)
  st$note = ifelse(suggested & !(!is.na(in_sheet) & in_sheet), "suggested from the recording order: check", st$note)
  st$note = ifelse(is.na(st$conc_M), "concentration unknown: type it in the conc_M cell", st$note)
  st[order(st$day, st$conc_M), c("file", "day", "letter", "conc_M", "include", "fit", "fit_sheet", "note", "datapath")]
}

# Parsed files are cached by path, so changing the reading time does not reread them
.emf_cache = new.env()
# Files that are not EMF16 exports are read as plain text: the first two numbers on
# each row are taken as time (s) and potential; potentials below 2 in absolute value
# are taken as volts and converted to mV.
read_trace_any = function(path) {
  emf = tryCatch(read_emf16_grf(path)$long, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(emf)) return(emf)
  x = sub("\r$", "", readLines(path, warn = FALSE))
  num = lapply(strsplit(trimws(x), "[,;\t ]+"), function(t) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(t)))
  ok = vapply(num, function(v) length(v) >= 2 && !anyNA(v[1:2]), TRUE)
  if (sum(ok) < 5) stop("Could not read ", basename(path), ": it is neither an EMF16 file nor a text file ",
                        "with two numeric columns (time in s, potential).")
  m = do.call(rbind, lapply(num[ok], `[`, 1:2))
  mv = if (max(abs(m[, 2])) < 2) m[, 2] * 1000 else m[, 2]
  data.frame(time_s = m[, 1], channel = "1", emf_mV = mv)
}
emf_trace = function(path) {
  if (is.null(.emf_cache[[path]])) assign(path, read_trace_any(path), envir = .emf_cache)
  .emf_cache[[path]]
}

emf_at = function(path, read_at_s) {
  z = emf_trace(path)
  hit = abs(z$time_s - read_at_s) < 0.05
  if (!any(hit)) hit = which.min(abs(z$time_s - read_at_s))
  median(z$emf_mV[hit])
}

add_emf = function(st, read_at_s, background_I = 0, z = 1) {
  st = st[st$include, ]
  st$E_mV = vapply(st$datapath, emf_at, 0, read_at_s = read_at_s)
  g = davies_gamma(st$conc_M + background_I, z)
  st$neg_log_c = -log10(st$conc_M)
  st$neg_log_a = -log10(g * st$conc_M)
  st
}

# Per-day calibration over the standards marked fit, plus a summary over days
calibrate = function(pts, x = "neg_log_a", T_C = 25, z = 1) {
  S = nernst_S(T_C, z)
  per_day = do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pts, pts$day), function(d) {
    f = d[d$fit, ]
    if (nrow(f) < 2) return(NULL)
    m = lm(f$E_mV ~ f[[x]])
    data.frame(day = d$day[1], n = nrow(f), from_M = min(f$conc_M), to_M = max(f$conc_M),
               slope_mV_dec = unname(coef(m)[2]), intercept_mV = unname(coef(m)[1]),
               r2 = summary(m)$r.squared, pct_nernst = 100 * abs(coef(m)[2]) / S)
  }))
  if (is.null(per_day)) return(NULL)
  summary = data.frame(days = nrow(per_day), slope_mean = mean(per_day$slope_mV_dec),
                       slope_sd = if (nrow(per_day) > 1) sd(per_day$slope_mV_dec) else NA,
                       pct_nernst = 100 * abs(mean(per_day$slope_mV_dec)) / S,
                       r2_min = min(per_day$r2), r2_max = max(per_day$r2),
                       range = sprintf("%g to %g M", min(per_day$from_M), max(per_day$to_M)))
  list(per_day = per_day, summary = summary, S = S)
}

# Change between neighbouring standards against the Nernstian expectation
steps_table = function(pts, x = "neg_log_a", T_C = 25, z = 1) {
  S = nernst_S(T_C, z)
  pts = pts[!pts$letter %in% c("X", "Y", "Z"), ]   # check-standard repeats are not calibration steps
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pts, pts$day), function(d) {
    d = d[order(d$conc_M), ]
    if (nrow(d) < 2) return(NULL)
    dx = diff(d[[x]])
    f = d[d$fit, ]
    sgn = if (nrow(f) >= 2) sign(coef(lm(f$E_mV ~ f[[x]]))[2]) else 1
    data.frame(day = d$day[1], from = d$letter[-nrow(d)], to = d$letter[-1],
               decades = -dx, measured_mV = diff(d$E_mV), expected_mV = sgn * S * dx,
               pct_nernst = 100 * diff(d$E_mV) / (sgn * S * dx))
  }))
}

# Fixed interference method (IUPAC; Umezawa et al. 2000, eq. 2)
fim = function(pts, flat_letters, nernst_letters, interf_M, zA = 1, zB = 1, T_C = 25) {
  per_day = do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pts, pts$day), function(d) {
    fl = d$E_mV[d$letter %in% flat_letters]
    nf = d[d$letter %in% nernst_letters, ]
    if (length(fl) < 1 || nrow(nf) < 2) return(NULL)
    e_flat = mean(fl)
    m = lm(E_mV ~ neg_log_a, data = nf)
    aA = 10^(-(e_flat - coef(m)[1]) / coef(m)[2])
    aB = davies_gamma(interf_M + aA, zB) * interf_M
    K = unname(aA / aB^(zA / zB))
    data.frame(day = d$day[1], flat_mV = e_flat, nernst_slope = unname(coef(m)[2]),
               a_primary_cross = unname(aA), a_interferent = aB, K = K, lgK = log10(K))
  }))
  if (is.null(per_day)) return(NULL)
  list(per_day = per_day,
       summary = data.frame(days = nrow(per_day), K_mean = mean(per_day$K),
                            K_sd = if (nrow(per_day) > 1) sd(per_day$K) else NA,
                            lgK_mean = mean(per_day$lgK),
                            lgK_sd = if (nrow(per_day) > 1) sd(per_day$lgK) else NA))
}

# Separate solution method, aA = aB (IUPAC eq. 6). The primary-ion potentials are
# averaged over the calibration days at each concentration. The sign follows the
# primary calibration, so the result does not depend on the instrument's sign
# convention.
ssm = function(primary, interferent, concs, zA = 1, zB = 1, T_C = 25) {
  S = nernst_S(T_C, zA)
  f = primary[primary$fit, ]
  s_sign = sign(coef(lm(f$E_mV ~ I(-f$neg_log_a)))[2])   # slope sign against log a
  out = do.call(rbind, lapply(concs, function(cc) {
    eA = primary$E_mV[abs(log10(primary$conc_M) - log10(cc)) < 1e-6]
    if (!length(eA)) return(NULL)
    ib = interferent[abs(log10(interferent$conc_M) - log10(cc)) < 1e-6, ]
    if (!nrow(ib)) return(NULL)
    aA = davies_gamma(cc, zA) * cc
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ib)), function(i) {
      lgk = s_sign * (ib$E_mV[i] - mean(eA)) / S + (1 - zA / zB) * log10(aA)
      data.frame(conc_M = cc, interferent_day = ib$day[i], E_primary_mean = mean(eA),
                 E_interferent = ib$E_mV[i], lgK = unname(lgk), K = unname(10^lgk))
    }))
  }))
  out
}

# Background-corrected Nernstian fit (Dagar et al. 2026, Sens. Actuators B 468,
# 140650, eq. 1): E = E0 + S log10(x + b_bkg), fitted to every included standard,
# so no linear range has to be chosen by eye. b_bkg is the effective background
# level that sets the lower limit of response. x is the activity or concentration,
# matching the chosen axis; the slope is reported against -log x, as the other fits.
fit_background = function(pts, x = "neg_log_a", T_C = 25, z = 1) {
  S = nernst_S(T_C, z)
  one_day = function(d) {
    v = 10^(-d[[x]])
    top = d[order(v, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(3, nrow(d)))], ]
    s0 = coef(lm(top$E_mV ~ I(-top[[x]])))[2]
    e0 = mean(top$E_mV - s0 * log10(10^(-top[[x]])))
    sse = function(p) sum((d$E_mV - (p[1] + p[2] * log10(v + 10^p[3])))^2)
    starts = lapply(-8:-3, function(lb) c(e0, s0, lb))
    best = NULL
    for (st in starts) {
      o = tryCatch(optim(st, sse, control = list(maxit = 5000, reltol = 1e-12)), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(o) && (is.null(best) || o$value < best$value)) best = o
    }
    p = best$par
    r2 = 1 - best$value / sum((d$E_mV - mean(d$E_mV))^2)
    data.frame(day = d$day[1], n = nrow(d), E0_mV = p[1], slope_mV_dec = -p[2], b_bkg_M = 10^p[3],
               r2 = r2, pct_nernst = 100 * abs(p[2]) / S)
  }
  per_day = do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pts, pts$day), function(d) if (nrow(d) >= 4) one_day(d)))
  if (is.null(per_day)) return(NULL)
  summary = data.frame(days = nrow(per_day), slope_mean = mean(per_day$slope_mV_dec),
                       slope_sd = if (nrow(per_day) > 1) sd(per_day$slope_mV_dec) else NA,
                       pct_nernst = 100 * abs(mean(per_day$slope_mV_dec)) / S,
                       b_bkg_mean = mean(per_day$b_bkg_M), b_bkg_sd = if (nrow(per_day) > 1) sd(per_day$b_bkg_M) else NA,
                       r2_min = min(per_day$r2), r2_max = max(per_day$r2))
  list(per_day = per_day, summary = summary, S = S, x = x)
}

# Curve of the background-corrected fit for plotting
background_curve = function(bg, x_range, n = 200) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(bg$per_day)), function(i) {
    r = bg$per_day[i, ]
    xs = seq(x_range[1], x_range[2], length.out = n)
    data.frame(day = r$day, xval = xs, E_mV = r$E0_mV - r$slope_mV_dec * log10(10^(-xs) + r$b_bkg_M))
  }))
}

# Precision from repeated readings of one check standard, with day as a random
# effect: linear mixed model fitted by REML with lme4 (Carnoli et al. 2024, Anal.
# Chim. Acta 1304, 342444). Within-day SD = repeatability; within and between
# combined = intermediate precision (ICH Q2(R2) terms). SDs in mV are also given as
# the equivalent concentration error at the theoretical Nernstian slope.
precision_check = function(pts, conc, T_C = 25, z = 1, min_days = 5) {
  d = pts[abs(log10(pts$conc_M) - log10(conc)) < 1e-6, ]
  S = nernst_S(T_C, z)
  pct = function(s) 100 * (10^(s / S) - 1)
  per_day = table(d$day)
  notes = character()
  if (length(per_day) < 2) return(list(notes = "Readings of this standard are needed on at least 2 days."))
  if (length(per_day) < min_days)
    notes = c(notes, sprintf("Only %d days: below the rule-of-thumb minimum of %d levels for a random effect (Carnoli et al. 2024). Treat the between-day SD as indicative only.",
                             length(per_day), min_days))
  if (all(per_day < 2)) {
    notes = c(notes, "Only one reading per day: repeatability (within-day SD) cannot be separated. The SD across days is the intermediate precision only.")
    s_ip = sd(d$E_mV)
    metrics = data.frame(metric = c("Repeatability (within-day SD)", "Between-day SD", "Intermediate precision"),
                         SD_mV = c(NA, NA, s_ip), conc_error_pct = c(NA, NA, pct(s_ip)))
    return(list(metrics = metrics, blup = NULL, notes = notes, n_days = length(per_day), n_readings = nrow(d)))
  }
  m = lme4::lmer(E_mV ~ 1 + (1 | day), data = d, REML = TRUE)
  vc = as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(m))
  s_b = vc$sdcor[vc$grp == "day"]
  s_w = vc$sdcor[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  if (lme4::isSingular(m))
    notes = c(notes, "Singular fit: the between-day variance could not be separated from zero with these data.")
  s_ip = sqrt(s_b^2 + s_w^2)
  metrics = data.frame(metric = c("Repeatability (within-day SD)", "Between-day SD", "Intermediate precision"),
                       SD_mV = c(s_w, s_b, s_ip), conc_error_pct = pct(c(s_w, s_b, s_ip)))
  re = lme4::ranef(m, condVar = TRUE)$day
  se = sqrt(attr(re, "postVar")[1, 1, ])
  blup = data.frame(day = rownames(re), effect_mV = re[, 1], lower = re[, 1] - 1.96 * se,
                    upper = re[, 1] + 1.96 * se, readings = as.integer(per_day[rownames(re)]))
  list(metrics = metrics, blup = blup, grand_mean = unname(lme4::fixef(m)[1]), notes = notes,
       n_days = length(per_day), n_readings = nrow(d))
}

# Calibration across days with a common slope and a random day baseline (and a
# random day slope when the data support it)
precision_calibration = function(pts, x = "neg_log_a", min_days = 5) {
  f = pts[pts$fit, ]
  f$xv = f[[x]]
  n_days = length(unique(f$day))
  notes = character()
  if (n_days < 2) return(list(notes = "Calibrations on at least 2 days are needed."))
  if (n_days < min_days)
    notes = c(notes, sprintf("Only %d days: below the rule-of-thumb minimum of %d (Carnoli et al. 2024). Between-day estimates are indicative only.", n_days, min_days))
  m1 = lme4::lmer(E_mV ~ xv + (1 | day), data = f, REML = TRUE)
  vc1 = as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(m1))
  if (lme4::isSingular(m1)) notes = c(notes, "Singular fit for the day baseline: its between-day variance could not be separated from zero.")
  m2 = suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(tryCatch(lme4::lmer(E_mV ~ xv + (1 + xv | day), data = f, REML = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)))
  slope_sd = if (!is.null(m2) && !lme4::isSingular(m2)) {
    v2 = as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(m2)); v2$sdcor[v2$grp == "day" & v2$var1 == "xv" & is.na(v2$var2)]
  } else NA
  if (is.na(slope_sd)) notes = c(notes, "Day-to-day slope variation could not be estimated from these data (random slope singular or not fitted).")
  list(table = data.frame(days = n_days, pooled_slope = unname(lme4::fixef(m1)[2]),
                          pooled_slope_se = sqrt(vcov(m1)[2, 2]),
                          between_day_baseline_sd = vc1$sdcor[vc1$grp == "day"],
                          between_day_slope_sd = slope_sd),
       notes = notes)
}

# Settling of each standard: the first time after which the drift over a sliding
# window stays below drift_mV_min (mV per minute) to the end of the recording.
# NA means the standard never settled within the file.
settling_table = function(pts, drift_mV_min = 1, window_s = 60, step_s = 5) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pts)), function(i) {
    z = emf_trace(pts$datapath[i]); z = z[!duplicated(z$time_s), ]
    end = max(z$time_s); grid = seq(window_s, end, by = step_s)
    e1 = approx(z$time_s, z$emf_mV, xout = grid)$y; e0 = approx(z$time_s, z$emf_mV, xout = grid - window_s)$y
    bad = which(abs(e1 - e0) >= drift_mV_min * window_s / 60)
    settled = if (!length(bad)) window_s else if (max(bad) == length(grid)) NA else grid[max(bad) + 1]
    data.frame(day = pts$day[i], letter = pts$letter[i], conc_M = pts$conc_M[i], fit = pts$fit[i],
               length_s = end, settled_s = settled)
  }))
}

# Calibration slope per day when the EMF is read at each of several times. A day is
# left out at a time longer than any of its fitted recordings. spread = range of the
# slope over the times from 'from_s' on; flagged when it exceeds flag_mV.
slope_by_time = function(pts, times = c(30, 60, 120, 180, 300, 420, 600), x = "neg_log_a", T_C = 25, z = 1,
                         from_s = 120, flag_mV = 2) {
  len = vapply(pts$datapath, function(p) max(emf_trace(p)$time_s), 0)
  long = do.call(rbind, lapply(times, function(t) {
    short_days = unique(pts$day[pts$fit & len < t])
    p = pts[!pts$day %in% short_days, ]
    if (!nrow(p)) return(NULL)
    p$E_mV = vapply(p$datapath, emf_at, 0, read_at_s = t)
    r = calibrate(p, x, T_C, z)
    if (is.null(r)) NULL else data.frame(read_s = t, r$per_day[, c("day", "slope_mV_dec", "r2", "pct_nernst")])
  }))
  if (is.null(long)) return(NULL)
  later = long[long$read_s >= from_s, ]
  spread = do.call(rbind, lapply(split(later, later$day), function(d) data.frame(
    day = d$day[1], times = nrow(d), slope_min = min(d$slope_mV_dec), slope_max = max(d$slope_mV_dec),
    spread_mV_dec = diff(range(d$slope_mV_dec)), flagged = diff(range(d$slope_mV_dec)) > flag_mV)))
  list(long = long, spread = spread, flag_mV = flag_mV, from_s = from_s)
}

# One reading time for the whole study, chosen by stability rather than by the slope:
# the earliest time by which the given share of the fitted standards, over all days,
# had settled. Choosing the time that gives the best slope separately for each
# dataset would bias the result, so it is not offered.
suggest_read_time = function(settle, share = 0.9, times = c(60, 120, 180, 240, 300, 420, 600)) {
  f = settle[settle$fit, ]
  if (!nrow(f)) return(NULL)
  ok = vapply(times, function(t) mean(!is.na(f$settled_s) & f$settled_s <= t), 0)
  hit = which(ok >= share)
  data.frame(share_wanted = share, read_s = if (length(hit)) times[min(hit)] else NA,
             share_settled = if (length(hit)) ok[min(hit)] else max(ok), fitted_standards = nrow(f),
             never_settled = sum(is.na(f$settled_s)))
}

# A small, faint credit on every figure the app or the scripts make: the name only, in light grey, so it does not
# draw the eye in a slide or a paper figure
tool_name = "ElectroFast"
# In the app it follows the "Name on figures" box of the user's own session (unticked: no text at all). Reading the
# input inside a plot makes the plot redraw when the box changes; outside a reactive context (a download) it is
# read without that link. Scripts and tests have no session, so they keep the credit.
watermark = function(text = tool_name) {
  s = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
  on = if (is.null(s)) TRUE else tryCatch(s$input$fig_credit, error = function(e) shiny::isolate(s$input$fig_credit))
  if (isFALSE(on)) return(list())
  list(ggplot2::labs(caption = text), ggplot2::theme(plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey80", hjust = 1)))
}

# "Label plots" box: when ticked, CV plots get sweep-direction arrows and their peak values, and Multi-Potential
# Steps traces get the potential of each step, the cycle numbers and the reading windows. Read like watermark();
# scripts and tests have no session and stay unlabelled.
labels_on = function() {
  s = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
  if (is.null(s)) return(FALSE)
  isTRUE(tryCatch(s$input$fig_labels, error = function(e) shiny::isolate(s$input$fig_labels)))
}

# Every figure the app saves for download goes through fig_save: ggsave, then an invisible note of the software in
# the file itself, so a figure made with ElectroFast can be recognised even with "Name on figures" unticked.
# PNG: tEXt chunks "Software" and "Creation Time" (PNG specification, section 11.3.4), shown by file properties
# and exiftool. SVG: a <metadata> element. The note is lost if the figure is converted or screenshotted.
fig_credit_text = function() paste(tool_name, if (exists("electrofast_version")) electrofast_version)
png_crc32 = local({
  tab = vapply(0:255, function(n) { c = n; for (k in 1:8) c = if (bitwAnd(c, 1) == 1) bitwXor(0xEDB88320 - 2^32, bitwShiftR(c, 1)) else bitwShiftR(c, 1); c }, 0)
  function(bytes) { c = -1L
    for (b in as.integer(bytes)) c = bitwXor(tab[bitwAnd(bitwXor(c, b), 255) + 1], bitwShiftR(c, 8))
    bitwXor(c, -1L) }
})
png_text_chunk = function(key, value) {
  data = c(charToRaw("tEXt"), charToRaw(enc2native(key)), as.raw(0), charToRaw(iconv(value, "UTF-8", "latin1", sub = "?")))
  be32 = function(x) { x = as.numeric(x); if (x < 0) x = x + 2^32; as.raw(c(x %/% 2^24, (x %/% 2^16) %% 256, (x %/% 2^8) %% 256, x %% 256)) }
  c(be32(length(data) - 4), data, be32(png_crc32(data)))
}
fig_stamp = function(file) {
  ext = tolower(tools::file_ext(file)); note = fig_credit_text()
  if (ext == "png") {
    b = readBin(file, "raw", file.size(file))
    if (length(b) < 33 || !identical(b[13:16], charToRaw("IHDR"))) return(invisible(file))
    add = c(png_text_chunk("Software", note), png_text_chunk("Creation Time", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")))
    writeBin(c(b[1:33], add, b[-(1:33)]), file)   # after the 8-byte signature and the 25-byte IHDR chunk
  } else if (ext == "svg") {
    x = readLines(file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"); i = grep("<svg", x, fixed = TRUE)[1]
    if (!is.na(i)) { j = i; while (j < length(x) && !grepl(">", x[j], fixed = TRUE)) j = j + 1
      x = append(x, sprintf("<metadata>Made with %s</metadata>", note), after = j); writeLines(x, file, useBytes = TRUE) }
  }
  invisible(file)
}
fig_save = function(filename, ...) { ggplot2::ggsave(filename, ...); fig_stamp(filename) }

# Error notification that skips errors without a message. req() stops with an empty "silent" error; when a tryCatch
# catches one, showing it gave an empty red box.
notify_error = function(e, duration = 10) {
  m = conditionMessage(e)
  # the same message gets the same id, so Shiny replaces the pop-up instead of stacking a copy for every table and
  # plot that read the same file
  if (nzchar(trimws(m))) shiny::showNotification(m, type = "error", duration = duration, id = paste0("err_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", substr(m, 1, 80))))
  invisible(NULL)
}

name: R/app_electrode.R
content:
# Electrode panel shared by the tabs: the user picks a standard disk, types a disk or
# microelectrode diameter, gives the dimensions of a plate, strip, wire, band or
# (hemi)sphere, or enters the area directly. electrode_server() returns the geometric
# area (cm2), the radius (cm, for microelectrode equations) and a short description.
# (base R has %||% from 4.4.0; this keeps older R versions working)
if (!exists("%||%")) `%||%` = function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

electrode_ui = function(id, label = "Electrode", allow_none = FALSE, default = "preset") {
  ns = NS(id)
  shapes = c("Standard disk (pick a size)" = "preset", "Disk, enter the diameter" = "disk",
             "Microdisk, enter the diameter in µm" = "microdisk", "Plate or strip" = "rectangle",
             "Wire or rod" = "wire", "Band" = "band", "Hemisphere" = "hemisphere", "Sphere" = "sphere",
             "Enter the area (cm²)" = "area")
  if (allow_none) shapes = c("Not given" = "none", shapes)
  sizes = stats::setNames(as.character(electrode_sizes$d_mm), electrode_sizes$label)
  tagList(
    selectInput(ns("shape"), label, shapes, selected = default),
    conditionalPanel("input.shape == 'preset'", ns = ns, selectInput(ns("preset"), "Size", sizes, selected = "2")),
    conditionalPanel("['disk', 'hemisphere', 'sphere', 'wire'].indexOf(input.shape) >= 0", ns = ns,
                     numericInput(ns("d_mm"), "Diameter (mm)", 2, min = 0)),
    conditionalPanel("input.shape == 'microdisk'", ns = ns, numericInput(ns("d_um"), "Diameter (µm)", 10, min = 0)),
    conditionalPanel("['rectangle', 'wire', 'band'].indexOf(input.shape) >= 0", ns = ns,
                     numericInput(ns("len_mm"), "Length in the solution (mm)", 10, min = 0)),
    conditionalPanel("['rectangle', 'band'].indexOf(input.shape) >= 0", ns = ns,
                     numericInput(ns("wid_mm"), "Width (mm)", 5, min = 0)),
    conditionalPanel("input.shape == 'rectangle'", ns = ns,
                     radioButtons(ns("faces"), NULL, c("One face exposed" = 1, "Both faces" = 2), inline = TRUE),
                     checkboxInput(ns("edges"), "Add the immersed edges", FALSE),
                     conditionalPanel("input.edges", ns = ns, numericInput(ns("thick_mm"), "Thickness (mm)", 0.1, min = 0))),
    conditionalPanel("input.shape == 'wire'", ns = ns, checkboxInput(ns("wire_end"), "Add the flat end", TRUE)),
    conditionalPanel("input.shape == 'area'", ns = ns, numericInput(ns("area"), "Area (cm²)", 0.0314, min = 0)),
    textOutput(ns("area_txt"), container = function(...) tags$small(class = "text-muted", ...)))
}

electrode_server = function(id) moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
  geo = reactive({
    s = input$shape; if (is.null(s) || s == "none") return(list(area_cm2 = NA_real_, r_cm = NA_real_, shape = "none", text = "No electrode size given"))
    d = switch(s, preset = as.numeric(input$preset), microdisk = input$d_um / 1000, input$d_mm)
    shape = switch(s, preset = "disk", microdisk = "disk", s)
    a = tryCatch(electrode_area(shape, d_mm = d, length_mm = input$len_mm, width_mm = input$wid_mm,
                                faces = as.numeric(input$faces %||% 1), edges = isTRUE(input$edges),
                                thickness_mm = input$thick_mm %||% 0, wire_end = isTRUE(input$wire_end), area_cm2 = input$area),
                 error = function(e) NA_real_)
    r = if (shape %in% c("disk", "hemisphere", "sphere") && !is.null(d)) d / 20 else NA_real_
    txt = sprintf("Geometric area %s cm²%s", format(signif(a, 4)), if (!is.na(r) && r < 0.0025) sprintf(", radius %g µm", r * 1e4) else "")
    list(area_cm2 = a, r_cm = r, shape = shape, text = txt)
  })
  output$area_txt = renderText(geo()$text)
  geo
})

Few methods, if any, are specific (Vessman et al. 2001)."), guide_section("Stability", "The signal of one standard at intervals (days, hours or cycles).", "The signal retained as a percentage of the first, the straight-line change per unit time and when it first falls below the limit.", "Measure the same standard in the same way each time, so the change reflects the sensor and not the measurement."), guide_section("Speed", "One recording (EMF16, or a potentiostat export) with an addition, and the time of the addition.", "The baseline, final level, change, and the response times t90 and t95.", "The final level is the median over the end of the recording: the signal must have settled by then, or t90 and t95 are too short."), guide_section("Precision", "Repeated results with any of the columns day, electrode and laboratory.", "Repeatability, between-day and between-electrode SD, intermediate precision, and reproducibility when two or more laboratories are present (ICH Q2(R2) terms), each with its RSD.", "Five or more levels of each grouping are usually needed for a reliable SD. Electrode-to-electrode variation is part of the intermediate precision, not the reproducibility."), h4("Other tabs", style = "margin-top: 2rem;"), guide_section("QC charts", "A QC history CSV from an earlier visit, the results of this session (one click), or values typed in.", "Control charts with limits from a reference period and the Westgard rules (1-3s, 2-2s, R-4s, 4-1s, 10x), with things to check when a rule breaks.", "Set the reference period to sessions known to be good. Download the history at the end: it is not kept on the server."), guide_section("Cell diagram", "The cell type (three electrodes, two compartments, rotating disk, or two electrodes on a patch-clamp amplifier), the electrodes, the electrolyte or solutions, an optional analyte and the instrument, typed in. A photo of the cell is optional and only shown alongside.", "A schematic (PNG, PDF or SVG) with each part labelled beside the drawing, drawn only from what was entered, and optionally a section in the report.", "A blank field shows only the role (for example \"Working electrode\"). Compare the drawing with the cell before using it."), guide_section("Report", "Nothing new: it collects every tab that has data.", "An HTML, PDF or PowerPoint report, and a reproducibility bundle (every setting, file checksums, package versions, every results table and the code).", "The version and file checksums at the top of the report identify exactly what was analysed and with which version."), tags$hr(style = "margin: 1.4rem 0 1.1rem; border-top: 1px solid #D5D9DE; opacity: 1;"), p("Every equation and its source is on the Equations tab under Techniques.") )))

name: R/app_methods_ui.R
content:
# User interface of the technique tabs: surface area (monolayer charge and double-layer
# capacitance), cyclic voltammetry (peaks, scan rate, k0, electroactive area, adsorbed
# species), Tafel, pulse voltammetry calibration, open-circuit potential,
# chronoamperometry (with Cottrell and microelectrode equations), chronocoulometry,
# chronopotentiometry, rotating disk, RRDE, impedance and a list of the equations used.
# Every tab that needs an area has the shared electrode panel (R/app_electrode.R). The
# server side is in app_methods_server.R.

file_types = c(".txt", ".csv", ".dat", ".pssession", ".mpt", ".mpr", ".dta", ".DTA", ".abf")
# an upload box with a line under it saying how each file was read (filled in by the server, see readas_line)
file_in = function(id, ...) tagList(fileInput(id, ...), uiOutput(paste0(id, "_readas"), class = "small text-muted", style = "margin-top: 0.35rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.35;"))
conc_help = helpText("Concentrations are suggested from the file names (for example '+ 50mM EtOH' gives 50, a file",
                     "without an added amount in such a series is the blank, 0). Check them in the table: double-click",
                     "a cell to change the concentration, or set include to FALSE to leave a file out.")
# (a function, because Shiny loads R/ in alphabetical order and electrochem.R comes later)
ecsa_choices = function() c(stats::setNames(ecsa_references$key, ecsa_references$label), "Other (enter below)" = "other")
probe_inputs = function(p) tagList(
  numericInput(paste0(p, "_n"), "Electrons transferred (n)", 1, min = 1),
  numericInput(paste0(p, "_C"), "Concentration of the redox species (mM)", 1, min = 0),

          plotOutput("ca_cmp_plot", height = "320px", fill = FALSE), plotOutput("ca_cmp_diff", height = "320px", fill = FALSE),
          helpText("Each file is averaged in 1000 bins over the time all files share, so spikes are averaged within a bin. The lower",
