R/spikes.R
content:
# Single-entity events in a current-time trace (for example particle impacts or collisions, or any other transient
# spikes): the baseline is a running median over a window much longer than an event, the noise is the robust SD of
# the baseline-corrected current (1.4826 x median absolute deviation), and an event is a run of points beyond
# k x noise. For each event: time of the peak, amplitude above the baseline, duration at half height, and charge
# (the corrected current integrated over the event, out to where it falls back inside 1 x noise).
# Current steps (a lasting change, as when particles stick and stay active) are not events here: the running median
# follows a step, so only its edge would show.

detect_spikes = function(t, I, base_s = 1, k = 5, polarity = c("positive", "negative", "both"), min_sep_s = 0) {
  polarity = match.arg(polarity)
  o = order(t); t = t[o]; I = I[o]; n = length(t)
  dt = stats::median(diff(t)); w = max(3, 2 * floor(base_s / dt / 2) + 1); w = min(w, if (n %% 2) n else n - 1)
  # very long traces (patch-clamp recordings hold millions of points): the running median is taken on every j-th point
  # and interpolated back, about 400 points per window; shorter traces use every point as before
  base = if (n > 2e5 && w > 801) { j = floor(w / 401); ks = seq(1, n, by = j); wk = 2 * floor(w / j / 2) + 1
    stats::approx(t[ks], as.numeric(stats::runmed(I[ks], min(wk, length(ks) - (1 - length(ks) %% 2)), endrule = "median")), xout = t, rule = 2)$y
  } else as.numeric(stats::runmed(I, w, endrule = "median"))
  r = I - base; noise = 1.4826 * stats::median(abs(r - stats::median(r)))
  s = switch(polarity, positive = r, negative = -r, both = abs(r))
  hit = s > k * noise
  empty = data.frame(t_peak_s = numeric(), amplitude_A = numeric(), duration_s = numeric(), charge_C = numeric(), t_start_s = numeric(), t_end_s = numeric())
  if (!any(hit)) return(list(events = empty, noise_A = noise, baseline = base, window_points = w, dt_s = dt))
  rl = rle(hit); ends = cumsum(rl$lengths); starts = ends - rl$lengths + 1
  runs = cbind(starts[rl$values], ends[rl$values])
  # runs closer than min_sep_s are one event
  if (nrow(runs) > 1 && min_sep_s > 0) {
    keep = list(runs[1, ]); for (i in 2:nrow(runs)) { last = keep[[length(keep)]]
      if (t[runs[i, 1]] - t[last[2]] < min_sep_s) keep[[length(keep)]] = c(last[1], runs[i, 2]) else keep[[length(keep) + 1]] = runs[i, ] }
    runs = do.call(rbind, keep)
  }
  # each run is widened to where the current falls back inside 1 x noise; runs that widen into the same stretch are
  # one event (without this merge, one event was listed once per run inside it)
  wide = t(apply(runs, 1, function(r) { a = r[1]; b = r[2]
    while (a > 1 && s[a - 1] > noise) a = a - 1
    while (b < n && s[b + 1] > noise) b = b + 1
    c(a, b) }))
  if (!is.matrix(wide)) wide = matrix(wide, ncol = 2)
  m = list(wide[1, ]); for (i in seq_len(nrow(wide))[-1]) { last = m[[length(m)]]
    if (wide[i, 1] <= last[2] + 1) m[[length(m)]] = c(last[1], max(last[2], wide[i, 2])) else m[[length(m) + 1]] = wide[i, ] }
  wide = do.call(rbind, m)
  ev = do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(wide)), function(i) {
    a = wide[i, 1]; b = wide[i, 2]
    j = a - 1 + which.max(s[a:b]); h = s[j] / 2
    l = j; while (l > a && s[l - 1] >= h) l = l - 1
    u = j; while (u < b && s[u + 1] >= h) u = u + 1
    q = if (b > a) sum(diff(t[a:b]) * (r[a:b][-1] + r[a:b][-(b - a + 1)]) / 2) else r[a] * dt
    data.frame(t_peak_s = t[j], amplitude_A = r[j], duration_s = t[u] - t[l] + dt, charge_C = q, t_start_s = t[a], t_end_s = t[b])
  }))
  list(events = ev, noise_A = noise, baseline = base, window_points = w, dt_s = dt)
}

spike_summary = function(file, t, res, k) {
  e = res$events; span = diff(range(t))
  data.frame(file = file, duration_s = span, noise_pA = 1e12 * res$noise_A, threshold_pA = 1e12 * k * res$noise_A, events = nrow(e),
             frequency_Hz = nrow(e) / span,
             median_amplitude_pA = if (nrow(e)) 1e12 * stats::median(e$amplitude_A) else NA,
             median_duration_ms = if (nrow(e)) 1e3 * stats::median(e$duration_s) else NA,
             median_charge_fC = if (nrow(e)) 1e15 * stats::median(e$charge_C) else NA)
}

name: R/steps.R
content:
# Single-entity steps in a current-time trace: lasting changes of the current, as when a particle lands on an
# ultramicroelectrode and stays active (a "staircase"). Spikes, which come and go, are found by detect_spikes().
# The current is averaged in short bins. At each bin edge the step statistic is the median of the bins after the edge
# minus the median of the bins before it (win_s on each side); medians keep spikes from looking like steps. The spread
# of this statistic over the whole trace (1.4826 x median absolute deviation) sets the noise, so slow noise and drift
# raise the threshold instead of giving false steps. A step is a local extreme of the statistic beyond k x that spread,
# at least one window from the next; its height is the statistic there.

detect_steps = function(t, I, bin_s = 0.01, win_s = 0.5, k = 6, direction = c("both", "up", "down")) {
  direction = match.arg(direction)
  o = order(t); t = t[o]; I = I[o]; n = length(t)
  dt = stats::median(diff(t[seq_len(min(n, 10000))]))
  b = max(1, round(bin_s / dt)); nb = floor(n / b)
  empty = data.frame(t_step_s = numeric(), height_A = numeric(), level_before_A = numeric(), level_after_A = numeric())
  W = max(3, round(win_s / (b * dt)))
  if (nb < 2 * W + 3) return(list(steps = empty, spread_A = NA_real_, bin_s = b * dt, window_bins = W, t_bin = numeric(), stat = numeric()))
  m = .colMeans(I[seq_len(nb * b)], b, nb)
  tb = t[seq(1, nb * b, by = b)] + (b - 1) * dt / 2
  # difference of medians either side of the edge after bin j
  j = W:(nb - W)
  before = vapply(j, function(i) stats::median(m[(i - W + 1):i]), 0)
  after = vapply(j, function(i) stats::median(m[(i + 1):(i + W)]), 0)
  D = after - before
  spread = 1.4826 * stats::median(abs(D - stats::median(D)))
  s = switch(direction, both = abs(D), up = D, down = -D)
  cand = which(s > k * spread)
  # local extremes, at least one window apart: the largest first, then anything within W bins of it is dropped
  keep = integer(0)
  for (i in cand[order(-s[cand])]) if (!length(keep) || all(abs(i - keep) >= W)) keep = c(keep, i)
  keep = sort(keep)
  # the median statistic is flat near an edge, so each edge is placed where the bins within one window either side
  # split best into two levels (least squares on the bin means)
  edge_bin = vapply(j[keep], function(e) {
    lo = max(1, e - W); hi = min(nb, e + W); seg = m[lo:hi]; L = length(seg)
    sse = vapply(1:(L - 1), function(c) sum((seg[1:c] - mean(seg[1:c]))^2) + sum((seg[(c + 1):L] - mean(seg[(c + 1):L]))^2), 0)
    lo - 1 + which.min(sse) }, 0)
  edge_t = (tb[edge_bin] + tb[pmin(edge_bin + 1, nb)]) / 2
  # a step within one window of a larger step is the settling of that step (an overshoot after a landing, for
  # example), not a separate event, so it is dropped
  if (length(keep) > 1) {
    h = abs(D[keep]); ok = vapply(seq_along(keep), function(i) !any(abs(edge_t - edge_t[i]) < W * b * dt & h > h[i]), TRUE)
    keep = keep[ok]; edge_t = edge_t[ok]
  }
  steps = if (length(keep)) data.frame(t_step_s = edge_t, height_A = D[keep], level_before_A = before[keep], level_after_A = after[keep]) else empty
  list(steps = steps, spread_A = spread, bin_s = b * dt, window_bins = W, t_bin = (tb[j] + tb[j + 1]) / 2, stat = D)
}

# one row per trace: how many steps, how often, their sizes, and the threshold used (k x spread)
step_summary = function(file, t, res, k) {
  s = res$steps; dur = diff(range(t))
  data.frame(file = file, steps = nrow(s), frequency_Hz = nrow(s) / dur,
             median_height_pA = if (nrow(s)) stats::median(s$height_A) * 1e12 else NA_real_,
             largest_pA = if (nrow(s)) s$height_A[which.max(abs(s$height_A))] * 1e12 else NA_real_,
             threshold_pA = k * res$spread_A * 1e12, spread_pA = res$spread_A * 1e12, bin_ms = res$bin_s * 1e3, window_s = res$window_bins * res$bin_s)
}

# For drawing long traces: in each of n_bins bins the lowest and the highest point, in time order, so spikes and steps
# stay visible while a 30-million-point recording is drawn from about 2 x n_bins points
thin_trace = function(t, y, n_bins = 4000) {
  n = length(t); if (n <= 2 * n_bins) return(data.frame(t = t, y = y))
  b = ceiling(n / n_bins); nb = floor(n / b); M = matrix(y[seq_len(nb * b)], nrow = b)
  rest = if (nb * b < n) { r = (nb * b + 1):n; c(r[which.min(y[r])], r[which.max(y[r])]) }   # the part after the last full bin
  idx = sort(unique(c((seq_len(nb) - 1) * b + apply(M, 2, which.min), (seq_len(nb) - 1) * b + apply(M, 2, which.max), rest, n)))
  data.frame(t = t[idx], y = y[idx])
}

# a current unit that suits the size of the current: pA, nA, µA or mA, as a scale factor and a label
current_unit = function(I) {
  m = max(abs(I), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(m) || m >= 1e-3) list(scale = 1e3, label = "mA") else if (m >= 1e-6) list(scale = 1e6, label = "µA") else
    if (m >= 1e-9) list(scale = 1e9, label = "nA") else list(scale = 1e12, label = "pA")
}

name: R/table_names.R
content:
# Readable column headers for the tables shown in the app and the reports. The calculations keep short code names
# (Epa_V, k0_nicholson_cm_s), which CSV downloads also keep so that scripts can read them back; round_df() turns them
# into headers such as "Epa (V)" and "k⁰, Nicholson (cm/s)" for display. A name with a space or a bracket is taken as
# readable already and left as it is.

# unit suffixes, longest first so that cm2_s is matched before s
table_units = c(
  "uA_mM_cm2" = "µA mM⁻¹ cm⁻²", "A_per_rad05" = "A rad⁻¹ᐟ²", "uC_cm2" = "µC/cm²", "uF_cm2" = "µF/cm²", "mol_cm2" = "mol/cm²",
  "mV_dec" = "mV/decade", "mV_min" = "mV/min", "cm2_s" = "cm²/s", "cm_s" = "cm/s", "V_s" = "V/s", "uA_mM" = "µA/mM",
  "cm2" = "cm²", "cm" = "cm", "um" = "µm", "mV" = "mV", "V" = "V", "mA" = "mA", "uA" = "µA", "nA" = "nA", "pA" = "pA", "A" = "A",
  "uC" = "µC", "fC" = "fC", "C" = "C", "uF" = "µF", "F" = "F", "ohm" = "Ω", "ms" = "ms", "s" = "s", "min" = "min", "Hz" = "Hz",
  "mM" = "mM", "M" = "M", "pct" = "%", "rpm" = "rpm")

# whole names, and symbols, that the general rule would not write well
table_labels = c(
  file = "File", day = "Day", date = "Date", note = "Note", conc = "Concentration", conc_M = "Concentration (M)",
  n = "n", N = "N", N_sd = "SD of N", K = "K", z = "z", r2 = "R²", se = "SE", sd = "SD", mean = "Mean", AICc = "AICc", dAICc = "ΔAICc", BIC = "BIC",
  chi2_red = "Reduced χ²", nrmse_pct = "NRMSE (%)", rel_se_pct = "Error (%)", worst_rel_se_pct = "Largest parameter error (%)",
  lgK = "log K", pct_nernst = "% of Nernstian", nernst_slope = "Nernstian slope (mV/decade)", decades = "Decades",
  Epa_V = "Epa (V)", Epc_V = "Epc (V)", ipa_A = "ipa (A)", ipc_A = "ipc (A)", dEp_mV = "ΔEp (mV)", E_half_V = "E½ (V)",
  ratio_ipa_ipc = "ipa / ipc", regime = "Regime", v_V_s = "Scan rate (V/s)",
  scan_rate_V_s = "Scan rate (V/s)", k0_nicholson_cm_s = "k⁰, Nicholson (cm/s)", k0_klingler_kochi_cm_s = "k⁰, Klingler-Kochi (cm/s)",
  k0_K_table_cm_s = "k⁰, K table (cm/s)", peak = "Peak", against = "Against", slope_se = "SE of the slope", slope_unit = "Slope unit",
  intercept_se_A = "SE of the intercept (A)", intercept_pct_of_smallest_ip = "Intercept (% of the smallest peak)", loglog_slope = "Log-log slope", loglog_slope_se = "SE of the log-log slope", alpha_K_table = "α from the K table", k0_note = "k⁰ note", alpha_from_width = "α from the peak width (irreversible)",
  E0_mV = "E⁰ (mV)", E_V = "E (V)", I_A = "I (A)", E_quarter_V = "E at τ/4 (V)", tau_s = "τ (s)", ECSA_cm2 = "ECSA (cm²)",
  Q_uC = "Q (µC)", q_ref_uC_cm2 = "Charge density (µC/cm²)", D_cm2_s = "D (cm²/s)", b_bkg_M = "Background b (M)",
  i_k_A = "Kinetic current (A)", I_disk_A = "Disk current (A)", I_ring_A = "Ring current (A)", ring_E_V = "Ring potential (V)",
  FE_mean_pct = "Faradaic efficiency, mean (%)", FE_sd_pct = "Faradaic efficiency, SD (%)", H2O2_mean_pct = "H₂O₂ yield, mean (%)",
  H2O2_sd_pct = "H₂O₂ yield, SD (%)", n_mean = "n, mean", n_sd = "n, SD", n_ref = "Reference sessions", n_from_slope = "n from the slope",
  slope_A_per_rad05 = "Slope (A rad⁻¹ᐟ²)", lod = "LOD", loq = "LOQ", at_bound = "At bound", recommended = "Recommended",
  a_primary_cross = "Primary-ion activity at the crossing", a_interferent = "Interferent activity", E_interferent = "E, interferent (mV)",
  E_primary_mean = "E, primary ion, mean (mV)", cross_reactivity_pct = "Cross-reactivity (%)", within_tolerance = "Within tolerance",
  signal_analyte = "Signal, target alone", signal_mixture = "Signal, with interferent", interferent_concentration = "Interferent concentration",
  median_charge_fC = "Median charge (fC)", median_amplitude_pA = "Median amplitude (pA)", median_duration_ms = "Median duration (ms)",
  median_height_pA = "Median height (pA)", unsettled_share = "Share unsettled", low_end_ratio = "Low-end ratio", background_ratio = "Background ratio",
  slope_min = "Lowest slope (mV/decade)", slope_max = "Highest slope (mV/decade)", times = "Reading times", rates = "Rotation rates", rpm = "Rotation rate (rpm)",
  t_start_s = "Start (s)", t_end_s = "End (s)", t_peak_s = "Peak time (s)", t_step_s = "Step time (s)", largest_pA = "Largest step (pA)",
  flat_mV = "Plateau (mV)", flat_sd = "Plateau SD (mV)", run_s = "Run length (s)", settled_s = "Settled after (s)", bin_ms = "Bin width (ms)",
  interferent_day = "Interferent day", to = "To", to_M = "To (M)", from = "From", from_M = "From (M)",
  pooled_slope = "Pooled slope (mV/decade)", pooled_slope_se = "SE of the pooled slope (mV/decade)",
  between_day_baseline_sd = "Between-day SD of the baseline (mV)", between_day_slope_sd = "Between-day SD of the slope (mV/decade)")

nice_names = function(x) vapply(x, function(nm) {
  if (nm %in% names(table_labels)) return(table_labels[[nm]])
  if (grepl("[ (]", nm) || !nzchar(nm)) return(nm)
  unit = ""
  for (u in names(table_units)) if (endsWith(nm, paste0("_", u)) && nchar(nm) > nchar(u) + 1) { unit = table_units[[u]]; nm = substr(nm, 1, nchar(nm) - nchar(u) - 1); break }
  w = gsub("_", " ", nm)
  w = sub("\\bk0\\b", "k⁰", sub("\\bd([A-Z])", "Δ\\1", w))
  if (grepl("^[a-z]{2,}", w)) w = paste0(toupper(substr(w, 1, 1)), substring(w, 2))
  if (nzchar(unit)) sprintf("%s (%s)", w, unit) else w
}, "", USE.NAMES = FALSE)

name: app_methods_server.R
content:
# Server side of the technique tabs (UI in R/app_methods_ui.R). Kept outside R/ because Shiny
# runs every file in R/ at start-up, and this one only works inside the app's server function,
# where it is sourced with local = TRUE, so it uses that function's input, output, session
# and its renderPlot (which falls back to a default size on hidden tabs).

g_theme = function() list(ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12), watermark())
pal = function(n) rep(cycle_palette("#CC9900"), length.out = n)

# Files are read once per upload and kept by path
.methods_cache = new.env()
read_up = function(files) if (is.null(files) || !NROW(files)) NULL else lapply(seq_len(NROW(files)), function(i) {
  # the instrument choice is part of the key, so changing it reads the file again with the chosen reader
  inst = input$instrument %||% "auto"; key = paste(files$datapath[i], inst)
  if (is.null(.methods_cache[[key]])) assign(key, read_echem(files$datapath[i], files$name[i], inst), envir = .methods_cache)
  .methods_cache[[key]]
})
# One line per uploaded file saying how it was read: the instrument recognised (or chosen), the technique, the
# number of points, segments and scan rate; EMF16 recordings with their channels and length; impedance files with
# their frequencies. Uses the same cached read as the analysis, so a large file is not read twice.
format_labels = c(chi = "CH Instruments", pssession = "PalmSens session", mpr = "BioLogic EC-Lab binary (.mpr)", biologic = "BioLogic EC-Lab text (.mpt)",
                  gamry = "Gamry", pine = "Pine AfterMath", abf = "Axon pCLAMP (.abf)", text = "text/CSV (columns read by their names)")
readas_line = function(path, name, inst = "auto") {
  fmt = tryCatch(instrument_format(path, name, inst), error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(fmt, "error")) return(paste("Not read:", conditionMessage(fmt)))
  if (fmt == "text" && any(grepl("^\\s*Time\\s*/\\s*s", readLines(path, n = 40, warn = FALSE)))) {
    z = tryCatch(read_emf16_grf(path), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(z)) return(sprintf("Read as: Lawson Labs EMF16, %d channel(s), %d points, %.0f s", length(z$channels), nrow(z$wide), max(z$wide$time_s)))
  }
  key = paste(path, inst)
  x = .methods_cache[[key]] %||% tryCatch({ r = read_echem(path, name, inst); assign(key, r, envir = .methods_cache); r }, error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(x, "error") || isTRUE(x$kind == "eis")) {
    e = tryCatch(read_eis(path, name, inst), error = function(e2) NULL)
    if (!is.null(e)) return(sprintf("Read as: %s, impedance, %d frequencies", format_labels[[fmt]], nrow(e$data)))
    return(paste("Not read:", if (inherits(x, "error")) conditionMessage(x) else "no data found"))
  }
  d = x$data; p = x$params
  parts = c(format_labels[[fmt]], if (identical(p$technique, "text export")) NA else p$technique %||% NA, sprintf("%d points", nrow(d)),
            if (!is.null(d$segment) && max(d$segment, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) sprintf("%d segments", max(d$segment, na.rm = TRUE)),
            if (isTRUE(is.finite(p$scan_rate_V_s))) sprintf("%g V/s", p$scan_rate_V_s))
  paste("Read as:", paste(parts[!is.na(parts) & nzchar(parts)], collapse = ", "))
}
for (id in c("dl_files", "sr_files", "tf_file", "pv_files", "oc_files", "ca_files", "cc_files", "cc_blank", "cp_files", "rd_files", "rr_cal_files",
             "rr_fe_files", "ei_file", "pq_file", "cal_files", "fim_files", "ssm_files", "ecsa_file", "sa_files")) local({ id = id
  output[[paste0(id, "_readas")]] = renderUI({ f = req(input[[id]]); k = seq_len(min(nrow(f), 20))
    lines = vapply(k, function(i) paste0(f$name[i], ": ", readas_line(f$datapath[i], f$name[i], input$instrument %||% "auto")), "")
    tagList(lapply(lines, tags$div), if (nrow(f) > 20) tags$div(sprintf("and %d more files", nrow(f) - 20))) })
})
safe_read = function(files) tryCatch(read_up(files), error = function(e) {
  notify_error(e, duration = 12); NULL })

# Editable concentration table shared by the calibration tabs
conc_table = function(files_id, unit_id, table_id) {
  tbl = reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(list(input[[files_id]], input[[unit_id]]), {
    f = req(input[[files_id]])
    v = conc_from_name(f$name, input[[unit_id]])
    tbl(data.frame(file = f$name, conc = v, include = TRUE,
                   note = ifelse(is.na(v), "no concentration found in the name: type it", "suggested from the file name")))
  })
  output[[table_id]] = DT::renderDT(DT::datatable(req(tbl()), rownames = FALSE, selection = "none",
    editable = list(target = "cell", disable = list(columns = c(0, 3))), options = list(pageLength = 50, dom = "t")))
  observeEvent(input[[paste0(table_id, "_cell_edit")]], {
    e = input[[paste0(table_id, "_cell_edit")]]; d = tbl()
    if (e$col == 1) { d$conc[e$row] = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(e$value)); d$note[e$row] = "entered by hand" }
    if (e$col == 2) d$include[e$row] = toupper(trimws(e$value)) %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES")
    tbl(d)
  })
  tbl
}
# points table with the fitted line appended, for the CSV downloads
add_line = function(p, cl) if (is.null(cl)) p else cbind(p, stats::setNames(cl, paste0("line_", names(cl))))
fmt_line = function(cl, unit, yunit = "A") {
  if (is.null(cl)) return(data.frame(Note = "At least 3 included standards with a concentration above 0 are needed for a line."))
  data.frame(Standards = cl$n, Range = sprintf("%g to %g %s", cl$from, cl$to, unit),
             Slope = sprintf("%.4g %s/%s", cl$slope, yunit, unit), Intercept = sprintf("%.4g %s", cl$intercept, yunit),
             `R²` = sprintf("%.4f", cl$r2), LOD = sprintf("%.3g %s", cl$lod, unit), `LOD basis` = cl$lod_basis, check.names = FALSE)
}
cal_plot_obj = function(pts, cl, unit, ylab) {
  g = ggplot2::ggplot(pts, ggplot2::aes(conc, y * 1e6)) + ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = used), size = 2.6)
  if (!is.null(cl)) g = g + ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = cl$intercept * 1e6, slope = cl$slope * 1e6, colour = "#1A6FDF")
  g + ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), labels = c(`TRUE` = "In the fit", `FALSE` = "Not in the fit"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("Concentration (%s)", unit), y = ylab,
                  subtitle = if (is.null(cl)) NULL else sprintf("Slope %.4g µA/%s, R² %.4f, LOD %.3g %s", cl$slope * 1e6, unit, cl$r2, cl$lod, unit)) +
    g_theme()
}
traces_plot = function(xs, x, y, xlab, ylab, yscale = 1e6) {
  d = do.call(rbind, lapply(xs, function(o) data.frame(file = o$file, xv = o$data[[x]], yv = o$data[[y]] * yscale)))
  g = ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(xv, yv, colour = file)) + ggplot2::geom_path(linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal(length(xs)), name = NULL) + ggplot2::labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    g_theme() + ggplot2::theme(legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8))
  if (labels_on() && x == "E_V") g = g + cv_labels(d, sub("^.*\\((.*)\\).*$", "\\1", ylab))
  g
}

# "Label plots" on a voltammogram: on the last two sweeps of the first file, an arrow beside each sweep in its
# direction (4% of the current range off the curve, above an anodic sweep and below a cathodic one, so it does not
# hide the line) and the peak current with its potential. A maximum at the very end of a sweep is a vertex, not a
# peak, and is not labelled.
cv_labels = function(d, unit) {
  z = d[d$file == d$file[1], ]; s = cv_sweeps(z$xv); n = length(s$from)
  if (!n) return(list())
  yr = diff(range(z$yv, na.rm = TRUE)); out = list()
  for (i in utils::tail(seq_len(n), 2)) {
    w = z[s$from[i]:s$to[i], ]; m = nrow(w)
    if (m < 20) next
    an = w$xv[m] > w$xv[1]; dy = if (an) 0.04 * yr else -0.04 * yr
    a = w[round(0.35 * m), ]; b = w[round(0.45 * m), ]
    out = c(out, list(ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = a$xv, xend = b$xv, y = a$yv + dy, yend = b$yv + dy, linewidth = 0.7,
                                        arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.1, "in"), type = "closed"))))
    # the most prominent feature of the sweep, of either sign: a reduction peak on a cathodic sweep, or an oxidation
    # peak on it (ethanol on Pd oxidises on the return sweep too)
    dev = w$yv - stats::median(w$yv); k = which.max(abs(dev))
    if (k > 0.03 * m && k < 0.97 * m)
      out = c(out, list(ggplot2::annotate("point", x = w$xv[k], y = w$yv[k], size = 2),
                        # forward-sweep label to the right of its peak, return-sweep label to the left, so two
                        # close peaks do not print over each other
                        ggplot2::annotate("text", x = w$xv[k] + (if (an) 0.015 else -0.015) * diff(range(z$xv)),
                                          y = w$yv[k] + sign(dev[k]) * 0.05 * yr, size = 3.3, hjust = if (an) 0 else 1,
                                          label = sub("-", "−", sprintf("%.3g %s at %.3f V", w$yv[k], unit, w$xv[k])))))
  }
  out
}

# "Label plots" on Multi-Potential Steps traces: from the first file's settings, the potential of each step along
# the top, the cycle numbers, dashed lines between cycles, and the reading windows of the cycles that are used (the
# last avg_s of the last step of each cycle, after the cycles left out), as multistep_currents() reads them.
step_labels = function(x, ytop, yr, avg_s, skip) {
  st = x$params$settings
  k = sort(as.integer(sub("^E([0-9]+) \\(V\\)$", "\\1", grep("^E[0-9]+ \\(V\\)$", names(st), value = TRUE))))
  if (!length(k)) return(list())
  E = vapply(k, function(j) st[[sprintf("E%d (V)", j)]], 0); Tt = vapply(k, function(j) st[[sprintf("T%d (s)", j)]], 0)
  n = chi_setting(x, "Cycle", 1); per = sum(Tt)
  mid = rep((seq_len(n) - 1) * per, each = length(k)) + rep(cumsum(Tt) - Tt / 2, n)
  ends = seq_len(n) * per; used = seq_len(n) > min(skip, n - 1)
  list(ggplot2::annotate("rect", xmin = ends[used] - avg_s, xmax = ends[used], ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.3),
       ggplot2::annotate("text", x = mid, y = ytop, label = sub("-", "−", sprintf("%+.2f V", rep(E, n))), size = 2.7),
       if (n > 1) ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * per, y = ytop + 0.07 * yr, label = paste("Cycle", seq_len(n)), size = 3.3, fontface = "bold"),
       if (n > 1) ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = seq_len(n - 1) * per, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4))
}

# Electrode panels (geometric area, radius) of the tabs that need an area
el = lapply(c(sa = "sa_el", dl = "dl_el", sr = "sr_el", tf = "tf_el", ca = "ca_el", cc = "cc_el", cp = "cp_el",
              rd = "rd_el", ei = "ei_el"), electrode_server)
area_of = function(k) el[[k]]()$area_cm2
T_K = function(p) (input[[paste0(p, "_T")]] %||% 25) + 273.15
# picking a literature probe fills in its D; "Other" leaves the box for the user
for (p in c("sr", "ca", "cc", "rd", "ei")) local({ p = p
  observeEvent(input[[paste0(p, "_probe")]], {
    D = redox_probes$D_cm2_s[redox_probes$key == input[[paste0(p, "_probe")]]]
    if (length(D) && !is.na(D)) updateNumericInput(session, paste0(p, "_D"), value = D)
  })
})
nz = function(v) if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) NA else v

# Surface area from a CV peak
observeEvent(input$sa_preset, {
  r = ecsa_references[ecsa_references$key == input$sa_preset, ]
  if (!nrow(r)) return()
  updateNumericInput(session, "sa_q", value = r$q_uC_cm2)
  updateRadioButtons(session, "sa_dir", selected = r$sweep)
  # default windows for Pd and Au CVs vs Ag/AgCl (1 M KCl); for the other
  # methods only the charge and sweep are set, because the regions depend on the reference
  # electrode and electrolyte used
  w = list(pd_ox424 = c(0.60, 0.10), au_ox = c(1.30, 0.55))[[r$key]]
  if (!is.null(w)) { updateNumericInput(session, "sa_from", value = w[1]); updateNumericInput(session, "sa_to", value = w[2]) }
  else showNotification("Set the potential window to the peak of your own CV.", duration = 8)
})
sa_fits = reactive({
  xs = req(safe_read(req(input$sa_files)))
  lapply(xs, function(x) ecsa_window(x, c(input$sa_from, input$sa_to), input$sa_q, area_of("sa"), input$sa_dir))
})
sa_res = reactive(do.call(rbind, lapply(sa_fits(), `[[`, "result")))
output$sa_table = renderTable(round_df(sa_res()))
sa_plot_obj = reactive({
  f = sa_fits()
  sw = do.call(rbind, lapply(f, function(z) cbind(file = z$result$file, z$sweep)))
  wn = do.call(rbind, lapply(f, function(z) cbind(file = z$result$file, z$window)))
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = wn, ggplot2::aes(E_V, ymin = I_A * 1e6, ymax = base_A * 1e6, fill = file), alpha = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data = sw, ggplot2::aes(E_V, I_A * 1e6, colour = file), linewidth = 0.6) +

# Peaks of every CV with the regime and k0 from the peak separation
sr_pk = reactive({
  xs = req(safe_read(req(input$sr_files)))
  p = do.call(rbind, lapply(xs, cv_peaks, window = sr_win(), T_K = T_K("sr")))
  p = p[order(p$v_V_s), ]
  n = input$sr_n %||% 1; w = if (identical(input$sr_dir, "cathodic")) p$Epc_minus_Ep2_mV else p$Epa_minus_Ep2_mV
  p$regime = cv_regime(p$dEp_mV, n)
  # |Ep - Ep/2| = 1.857 RT/(alpha n F) holds for an irreversible wave only; a reversible wave is 56.5 mV wide whatever alpha is
  p$alpha_from_width = ifelse(p$regime == "irreversible", alpha_from_peak_width(w, n, T_K("sr")), NA)
  p$k0_nicholson_cm_s = k0_nicholson(p$dEp_mV, p$v_V_s, input$sr_D, n, T_K("sr"))
  p$k0_klingler_kochi_cm_s = k0_klingler_kochi(p$dEp_mV, p$v_V_s, input$sr_D, input$sr_alpha, n, T_K("sr"))
  # alpha and k0 from the simulated K(Lambda, alpha) table (peak separation and width together), quasi-reversible CVs
  kq = rs_quasi_K(p$dEp_mV, w, n, T_K("sr")); q = p$regime == "quasi-reversible"
  p$alpha_K_table = ifelse(q, kq$alpha, NA)
  p$k0_K_table_cm_s = ifelse(q, kq$psi * sqrt(pi * input$sr_D * n * p$v_V_s * F_const / (R_const * T_K("sr"))), NA)
  # near the reversible limit 1 to 2 mV of peak separation (sampling, switching potential) changes k0 by tens of percent
  p$k0_note = ifelse(n * p$dEp_mV < 70 & (q | is.finite(p$k0_nicholson_cm_s)), "nΔEp below 70 mV: k⁰ is very sensitive to ΔEp, so treat it as an estimate", "")
  p
})

# surface coverage from the peak charge (adsorbed species)
sr_ip = reactive({ p = sr_pk(); data.frame(v = p$v_V_s, ip = abs(if (input$sr_dir == "anodic") p$ipa_A else p$ipc_A)) })
sr_area_tab = reactive({
  if (input$sr_species == "ads") {
    xs = req(safe_read(req(input$sr_files))); A = area_of("sr")
    return(do.call(rbind, lapply(xs, function(x) {
      q = peak_charge(last_sweep(x, input$sr_dir), c(input$sr_qfrom, input$sr_qto), x$params$scan_rate_V_s)$Q_C
      G = surface_coverage(q, input$sr_n, A)
      data.frame(file = x$file, v_V_s = x$params$scan_rate_V_s, Q_uC = q * 1e6, Gamma_mol_cm2 = G,
                 ip_ideal_reversible_A = ip_surface(G, x$params$scan_rate_V_s, input$sr_n, A, T_K("sr")))
    })))
  }
  # Randles-Sevcik assumes only one form in the bulk. With both forms the CV starts with the other form
  # already being converted at the electrode, and the peaks read from zero come out larger (about 1.6x
  # for 1 + 1 mM ferri/ferro cycled from -0.2 V, by simulation), so no area or D is given from them.
  validate(need(!isTRUE(input$sr_mix), paste(
    "Randles–Ševčík needs a solution with only one form of the couple (for example 1 mM ferricyanide alone).",
    "With both forms present the peaks are larger than the equation assumes and the area would be too high.",
    "Use the Chronoamperometry tab (Cottrell) or the Chronocoulometry tab (Anson) instead. After a step from the rest potential",
    "to a potential where one form is fully converted, the current depends only on that form's concentration.")))
  d = sr_ip(); quasi = input$sr_rev == "quasi"; rev = input$sr_rev != "irr"
  # quasi-reversible: each peak is divided by its K(Lambda, alpha), then the reversible equation is used (Trachioti 2023, Fig. 6)
  kq = NULL
  if (quasi) {
    p = sr_pk(); w = if (input$sr_dir == "anodic") p$Epa_minus_Ep2_mV else p$Epc_minus_Ep2_mV
    kq = rs_quasi_K(p$dEp_mV, w, input$sr_n, T_K("sr"))
    kq$K[p$regime == "reversible"] = 1
    validate(need(!any(p$regime == "irreversible", na.rm = TRUE), "Some CVs are irreversible (n dEp above 200 mV): use the irreversible form for those."),
             need(all(is.finite(kq$K)), "K could not be read for every CV (peak separation outside 59 to 200 mV): check the peaks table."))
    d$ip = d$ip / kq$K
  }
  s = if (nrow(d) >= 2) unname(stats::coef(stats::lm(ip ~ sqrt(v), d))[2]) else d$ip / sqrt(d$v)
  r2 = if (nrow(d) >= 3) summary(stats::lm(ip ~ sqrt(d$v), d))$r.squared else NA
  out = rs_solve(s, input$sr_n, input$sr_C, if (input$sr_solve == "area") input$sr_D else NA,
                 if (input$sr_solve == "D") area_of("sr") else NA, T_K("sr"), rev, input$sr_alpha)
  note = if (quasi && any(kq$alpha_at_table_edge, na.rm = TRUE)) "peak width outside the table (alpha 0.3 to 0.7): alpha held at the edge"
    else if (!quasi && rev && any(sr_pk()$regime == "quasi-reversible", na.rm = TRUE))
      "some CVs are quasi-reversible. Their peaks are lower than reversible ones, so the reversible form underestimates the area. Use the quasi-reversible form"
    else ""
  parts = list(data.frame(scan_rates = nrow(d), slope_A_per_sqrtV_s = s, r2 = r2, form = c(rev = "reversible", quasi = "quasi-reversible (K)", irr = "irreversible")[[input$sr_rev]],
                           geometric_area_cm2 = area_of("sr")), out,
               if (quasi) data.frame(K_per_scan_rate = paste(signif(kq$K, 3), collapse = ", "), alpha_from_width = paste(signif(kq$alpha, 2), collapse = ", ")),
               data.frame(note = note))
  do.call(cbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), parts))
})

    return(g + ggplot2::labs(x = "Time (s)", y = paste0("Current (", u$label, ")"), subtitle = sprintf("%s: %d events (red), baseline (blue), threshold %s x noise", z$file, nrow(e), input$ca_k)) + g_theme())
  }
  if (input$ca_mode == "esteps") {
    z = ca_est()[[1]]; s = z$res$steps; u = current_unit(z$I); d = thin_trace(z$t, z$I * u$scale)
    g = ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(t, y)) + ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey45")
    if (nrow(s)) g = g + ggplot2::geom_point(data = data.frame(t = s$t_step_s, y = s$level_after_A * u$scale), colour = "#C0392B", shape = 17, size = 2)
    return(g + ggplot2::labs(x = "Time (s)", y = paste0("Current (", u$label, ")"), subtitle = sprintf("%s: %d steps (red, at the level after each step), threshold %s x spread", z$file, nrow(s), input$ca_ek)) + g_theme())
  }
  if (input$ca_mode == "cottrell") {
    d = do.call(rbind, lapply(ca_x(), function(x) { k = x$data$t_s > 0
      data.frame(file = x$file, x = 1 / sqrt(x$data$t_s[k]), y = abs(x$data$I_A[k]) * 1e6) }))
    lo = 1 / sqrt(input$ca_tto); hi = 1 / sqrt(input$ca_tfrom)
    return(ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, colour = file)) + ggplot2::geom_path(linewidth = 0.5) +
      ggplot2::annotate("rect", xmin = lo, xmax = hi, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.15, fill = "#1A6FDF") +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2 * hi)) + ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal(length(unique(d$file))), name = NULL) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = expression(italic(t)^{-1/2}*" (s"^{-1/2}*")"), y = expression("|"*italic(i)*"| (µA)"), subtitle = "Shaded: fitted time window") + g_theme())
  }
  r = ca_res(); r$y = ca_y(); r$used = r$include & !is.na(r$conc) & r$conc > 0 & r$conc >= input$ca_cfrom & r$conc <= input$ca_cto
  cal_plot_obj(r, ca_line(), input$ca_unit, "Current at the end of the step (µA)")
})

ca_check_table = function() { f = ca_check_df(); u = current_unit(c(f$min_A, f$max_A)); L = function(x) sprintf("%s (%s)", x, u$label)
  o = data.frame(File = f$file, Points = format(f$points, big.mark = ","), `Duration (s)` = signif(f$duration_s, 6), `Sampling (Hz)` = signif(f$sampling_Hz, 6),
                 Min = signif(f$min_A * u$scale, 5), Max = signif(f$max_A * u$scale, 5), Noise = signif(f$noise_A * u$scale, 3),
                 `Net change` = signif(f$net_change_A * u$scale, 4), Gaps = f$gaps, `At limit (%)` = signif(f$at_limit_pct, 2),
                 `Potential (V)` = f$E_V, `Filter (Hz)` = f$filter_Hz, check.names = FALSE)
  names(o)[names(o) %in% c("Min", "Max", "Noise", "Net change")] = L(c("Min", "Max", "Noise", "Net change"))
  o = o[, colSums(!is.na(o)) > 0, drop = FALSE]

  o[] = lapply(o, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) vapply(v, function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else format(signif(x, 4), scientific = abs(x) > 0 && (abs(x) < 1e-3 || abs(x) >= 1e7), drop0trailing = TRUE), "") else v)
  o }

  own = trimws(strsplit(input$ei_custom %||% "", ";")[[1]]); own = own[nzchar(own)]

  if (length(bad)) showNotification(paste("Not a valid circuit:", paste(bad, collapse = ", ")), type = "error", duration = 12)
  unique(c(input$ei_circuits, setdiff(own, bad))) })
ei_all = eventReactive(input$ei_run, {
  d = ei_d(); cs = req(ei_circs())
  withProgress(message = "Fitting circuits", value = 0, {
    fits = lapply(seq_along(cs), function(i) { incProgress(1 / length(cs), detail = cs[i])
      tryCatch(eis_fit(d, cs[i], input$ei_weight, input$ei_start, input$ei_bounds), error = function(e) {
        showNotification(sprintf("%s: %s", cs[i], conditionMessage(e)), type = "warning", duration = 10); NULL }) })
  })
  names(fits) = cs; fits = fits[!vapply(fits, is.null, TRUE)]
  rank = do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, function(f) data.frame(circuit = f$circuit, notation = f$notation, parameters = f$n_params,
    chi2 = f$chi2, chi2_red = f$chi2_red, nrmse_pct = f$nrmse_pct, AIC = f$aic, AICc = f$aicc, BIC = f$bic,
    worst_rel_se_pct = suppressWarnings(max(f$params$rel_se_pct, na.rm = TRUE)), at_bound = any(f$params$at_bound), converged = f$converged)))
  rank = rank[order(rank$AICc), ]; rank$dAICc = rank$AICc - min(rank$AICc)
  rank$flag = ifelse(!rank$converged, "optimizer did not converge",
               ifelse(!is.finite(rank$worst_rel_se_pct) | rank$worst_rel_se_pct > 100, "a parameter is not determined (error above 100%)",
               ifelse(rank$at_bound, "a parameter is at a bound", "")))
  rank$recommended = FALSE; ok = rank$flag == ""; if (any(ok)) rank$recommended[which(ok)[1]] = TRUE
  list(rank = rank, fits = fits, settings = list(file = input$ei_file$name, weighting = input$ei_weight, start = input$ei_start,
       bounds = input$ei_bounds, circuits = cs, when = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), points = nrow(d)))
})

# Technique tabs for the HTML report and the slide deck: one section per tab that has data,
# each with a few lines of text, its plots and its tables. A tab without data is left out.
tp = function(f) tryCatch(f(), error = function(e) NULL)
tp_section = function(title, text = NULL, plots = list(), tables = list()) {
  plots = Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(plots, tp)); tables = Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && NROW(x) > 0, lapply(tables, tp))
  if (!length(plots) && !length(tables)) return(NULL)
  list(title = title, text = tp(text), plots = plots, tables = tables)
}
technique_parts = function() Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  tp_section("Surface area (CV peak)", function() sprintf("Charge density %g µC/cm², window %g to %g V, last %s sweep.", input$sa_q, input$sa_from, input$sa_to, input$sa_dir),
             list(Voltammograms = sa_plot_obj), list(Results = function() round_df(sa_res()))),
  tp_section("Double-layer capacitance", function() sprintf("Charging current read at %g V, with C_s = %g µF/cm².", input$dl_E, input$dl_Cs),
             list(`Charging current against scan rate` = dl_plot_obj), list(Fit = function() round_df(dl_res()$fit), Points = function() round_df(dl_res()$points))),
  tp_section("CV: peaks, scan rate, kinetics", function() scan_rate_reading(sr_rate()),
             list(Voltammograms = sr_cv_plot_obj, `Peak currents against v and √v` = sr_lin_plot_obj, `Scan rate (log-log)` = sr_plot_obj,
                  `Peak current against √v (Randles–Ševčík)` = sr_rs_plot_obj),
             list(Peaks = function() round_df(sr_pk()[, c("file", "v_V_s", "Epa_V", "ipa_A", "Epc_V", "ipc_A", "dEp_mV", "regime", "k0_nicholson_cm_s", "k0_klingler_kochi_cm_s", "k0_K_table_cm_s", "k0_note")]),
                  `Scan-rate fits` = function() round_df(sr_rate()$fits), `Log-log slopes` = function() round_df(sr_rate()$loglog),
                  `Area, D or coverage` = function() round_df(sr_area_tab()))),
  tp_section("Tafel", function() sprintf("Fitted window %g to %g V.", input$tf_from, input$tf_to), list(`log I against E` = tf_plot_obj), list(`Chosen window` = function() round_df(tf_one()))),
  tp_section("DPV / SWV calibration", function() paste(unlist(fmt_line(pv_line(), input$pv_unit)), collapse = "; "),
             list(Calibration = pv_plot_obj, Voltammograms = pv_traces_obj), list(Points = function() round_df(pv_pts()[, c("file", "conc", "E_V", "I_A", "used")]))),
  tp_section("Open-circuit potential", NULL, list(Traces = oc_plot_obj), list(Results = function() round_df(oc_res()))),
  tp_section("Chronoamperometry", function() c(if (input$ca_mode %in% c("multistep", "steps")) paste(unlist(fmt_line(ca_line(), input$ca_unit)), collapse = "; ") else
               sprintf("Analysis: %s.", c(charge = "charge passed", cottrell = "Cottrell", ume = "microelectrode steady state",
                                          spikes = "single-entity spikes", esteps = "single-entity steps")[[input$ca_mode]]),
               tryCatch(file_check_notes(ca_check_df()), error = function(e) NULL)),
             list(Results = ca_plot_obj, `Current traces` = ca_traces_obj, `Events over time` = ca_x_rate_obj, `Event size over time` = ca_x_amp_t_obj,
                  `Amplitude against duration` = ca_x_amp_dur_obj, `Event sizes` = ca_x_hist_obj),
             c(list(Results = function() round_df(ca_res()), `File check` = ca_check_table),
               if (isTRUE(input$ca_mode == "spikes")) list(Events = function() round_df(utils::head(ca_events(), 200))),
               if (isTRUE(input$ca_mode == "esteps")) list(Steps = function() round_df(utils::head(ca_steps(), 200))))),
  tp_section("Chronocoulometry", NULL, list(`Anson plot` = cc_plot_obj), list(`Anson fit` = function() round_df(cc_res()))),
  tp_section("Chronopotentiometry", NULL, list(`Potential traces` = cp_plot_obj, `Sand line` = cp_sand_plot_obj),
             list(`Transition times` = function() round_df(cp_res()[, c("file", "conc", "current_A", "tau_s", "E_quarter_V", "note")]))),
  tp_section("Rotating disk", NULL, list(Voltammograms = rd_traces_obj, Levich = rd_lev_plot_obj, `Koutecky-Levich` = rd_kl_plot_obj),
             list(Levich = function() round_df(rd_lev()), `Koutecky-Levich` = function() round_df(rd_kl()$fits))),
  tp_section("RRDE", NULL, list(`Collection efficiency` = rr_cal_plot_obj, `Faradaic efficiency` = rr_fe_plot_obj),
             list(`Collection efficiency` = function() round_df(rr_cal()), `Faradaic efficiency` = function() round_df(do.call(rbind, lapply(rr_fe_fits(), `[[`, "summary"))))),
  tp_section("Impedance (EIS)", function() eis_interpret(ei_sel(), ei_kkr(), ei_ft()),
             list(`Circuit` = ei_diag_obj, Nyquist = ei_nyq_obj, `Bode magnitude` = ei_mag_obj, `Bode phase` = ei_ph_obj, `Fit residuals` = ei_res_obj, `Kramers-Kronig residuals` = ei_kk_plot_obj),
             list(`Circuit ranking` = function() round_df(ei_all()$rank[, c("circuit", "parameters", "AICc", "dAICc", "nrmse_pct", "worst_rel_se_pct", "flag", "recommended")]),
                  Parameters = function() round_df(ei_sel()$params)))))

name: app_performance_server.R
content:
# Server side of the Sensor performance menu (UI in R/app_performance_ui.R, calculations in R/performance.R).
# Sourced inside the server function with local = TRUE, after app_methods_server.R, whose g_theme, round_df and
# tp_section it uses.

perf_read = function(id) {
  f = req(input[[id]])
  tryCatch(utils::read.csv(f$datapath, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE),
           error = function(e) { notify_error(e, duration = 12); req(FALSE) })
}
# a calculation error becomes a message, and the tab stays empty
perf_try = function(f) tryCatch(f(), error = function(e) { notify_error(e, duration = 12); req(FALSE) })
perf_col = "#1A6FDF"
for (k in names(perf_templates)) local({ k = k
  id = c(sensitivity = "ps", selectivity = "pl", specificity = "pc", stability = "pt", precision = "pp")[[k]]
  output[[paste0(id, "_template")]] = downloadHandler(sprintf("%s_template.csv", k), function(f) utils::write.csv(perf_templates[[k]], f, row.names = FALSE))
})
lim = function(v) if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) NULL else v

# Sensitivity
ps_res = reactive(perf_try(function() perf_sensitivity(perf_read("ps_file"), lim(input$ps_from) %||% -Inf, lim(input$ps_to) %||% Inf, lim(input$ps_area) %||% NA)))
ps_tab = reactive({ f = ps_res()$fit; cu = input$ps_cunit; su = input$ps_sunit
  data.frame(Standards = f$n, `Linear range` = sprintf("%g to %g %s", f$from, f$to, cu),
             Sensitivity = sprintf("%.4g ± %.2g %s/%s", f$slope, f$slope_se, su, cu), Intercept = sprintf("%.4g %s", f$intercept, su),
             `R²` = sprintf("%.4f", f$r2), LOD = sprintf("%.3g %s", f$lod, cu), LOQ = sprintf("%.3g %s", f$loq, cu),
             `Noise s from` = if (f$blanks >= 2) sprintf("%d blanks", f$blanks) else "residual SD of the line",
             `Sensitivity per area` = if (is.na(f$slope_per_area)) "" else sprintf("%.4g %s %s⁻¹ cm⁻²", f$slope_per_area, su, cu), check.names = FALSE) })
ps_plot_obj = reactive({ r = ps_res(); f = r$fit
  ggplot2::ggplot(r$points, ggplot2::aes(concentration, signal)) + ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = used), size = 2.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = f$intercept, slope = f$slope, colour = perf_col) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), labels = c(`TRUE` = "In the fit", `FALSE` = "Not in the fit"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("Concentration (%s)", input$ps_cunit), y = sprintf("Signal (%s)", input$ps_sunit),
                  subtitle = sprintf("Sensitivity %.4g %s/%s, R² %.4f, LOD %.3g %s", f$slope, input$ps_sunit, input$ps_cunit, f$r2, f$lod, input$ps_cunit)) + g_theme() })
output$ps_plot = renderPlot(ps_plot_obj())
output$ps_table = renderTable(ps_tab())
output$ps_csv = downloadHandler("sensitivity.csv", function(f) utils::write.csv(ps_res()$fit, f, row.names = FALSE))

# Selectivity
pl_res = reactive(perf_try(function() perf_selectivity(perf_read("pl_file"), input$pl_tol %||% 5)))
pl_plot_obj = reactive({ d = pl_res(); d$lab = trimws(paste(d$interferent, d$interferent_concentration)); tol = input$pl_tol %||% 5
  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(stats::reorder(lab, abs(change_pct)), change_pct)) +
    ggplot2::annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -tol, ymax = tol, fill = "#E8EEF6") +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") + ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = perf_col) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() + ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Change of the analyte signal (%)", subtitle = sprintf("Shaded: within ±%g%%", tol)) + g_theme() })
output$pl_plot = renderPlot(pl_plot_obj())
pl_tab = reactive({ d = pl_res(); d$within_tolerance = ifelse(d$within_tolerance, "yes", "no"); round_df(d) })
output$pl_table = renderTable(pl_tab())
output$pl_csv = downloadHandler("selectivity.csv", function(f) utils::write.csv(pl_res(), f, row.names = FALSE))

# Specificity
pc_res = reactive(perf_try(function() perf_specificity(perf_read("pc_file"))))
pc_plot_obj = reactive({ d = pc_res()
  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(stats::reorder(species, cross_reactivity_pct), cross_reactivity_pct, fill = target)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6) + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = perf_col, `FALSE` = "#8C96A3"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "Target", `FALSE` = "Other species"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() + ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Response relative to the target (%)") + g_theme() })
output$pc_plot = renderPlot(pc_plot_obj())
pc_tab = reactive({ d = pc_res(); d$target = ifelse(d$target, "yes", "no"); names(d)[names(d) == "signal"] = sprintf("Signal (%s)", input$pc_sunit)
  names(d)[names(d) == "selectivity_ratio"] = "Selectivity ratio (target / species)"; round_df(d) })
output$pc_table = renderTable(pc_tab())
output$pc_csv = downloadHandler("specificity.csv", function(f) utils::write.csv(pc_res(), f, row.names = FALSE))

# Stability
pt_res = reactive(perf_try(function() perf_stability(perf_read("pt_file"), input$pt_limit %||% 90)))
pt_plot_obj = reactive({ r = pt_res(); lim = input$pt_limit %||% 90
  ggplot2::ggplot(r$points, ggplot2::aes(time, retention_pct)) + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = lim, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    ggplot2::geom_line(colour = perf_col) + ggplot2::geom_point(colour = perf_col, size = 2.6) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("Time (%s)", input$pt_tunit), y = "Signal retained (% of the first)", subtitle = sprintf("Dashed: %g%% limit", lim)) + g_theme() })
output$pt_plot = renderPlot(pt_plot_obj())
pt_tab = reactive({ s = pt_res()$summary; u = input$pt_tunit
  data.frame(Measurements = s$times, `Last time` = sprintf("%g %s", s$last_time, u), `Retained at the last time` = sprintf("%.1f%%", s$retained_at_last_pct),
             `Change (straight line)` = sprintf("%.3g%% per %s", s$change_pct_per_unit, sub("s$", "", u)),
             `Below the limit from` = if (is.na(s$first_time_below_limit)) sprintf("not below %g%%", s$limit_pct) else sprintf("%.3g %s", s$first_time_below_limit, u), check.names = FALSE) })
output$pt_table = renderTable(pt_tab())
output$pt_csv = downloadHandler("stability.csv", function(f) utils::write.csv(pt_res()$points, f, row.names = FALSE))

# Speed
pq_x = reactive({ f = req(input$pq_file); perf_try(function() perf_trace(f$datapath, f$name, input$instrument %||% "auto", input$pq_channel)) })
observeEvent(input$pq_file, {
  x = tryCatch(perf_trace(input$pq_file$datapath, input$pq_file$name, input$instrument %||% "auto"), error = function(e) NULL)
  updateSelectInput(session, "pq_channel", choices = if (is.null(x$channels)) character(0) else x$channels)
})
pq_res = reactive({ x = pq_x(); ta = req(lim(input$pq_tadd))
  perf_try(function() perf_speed(x$t, x$y, ta, input$pq_pre %||% 2, input$pq_post %||% 10, input$pq_smooth %||% 0.2)) })
pq_plot_obj = reactive({ x = pq_x(); th = thin_trace(x$t, x$y * x$scale); d = data.frame(t = th$t, y = th$y)
  g = ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(t, y)) + ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + ggplot2::labs(x = "Time (s)", y = x$label) + g_theme()
  r = tryCatch(pq_res(), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r)) return(g)
  g + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = r$t_add_s, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = c(r$baseline, r$final) * x$scale, colour = perf_col, linewidth = 0.4) +
    (if (!is.na(r$t90_s)) ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = r$t_add_s + r$t90_s, colour = perf_col)) +
    ggplot2::labs(subtitle = sprintf("Dashed: addition. Lines: baseline, final level and t90 (%s s)", format(signif(r$t90_s, 3)))) })
output$pq_plot = renderPlot(pq_plot_obj())
pq_tab = reactive({ r = pq_res(); x = pq_x(); u = sub("^.*\\((.*)\\)$", "\\1", x$label)
  data.frame(File = x$file, Channel = x$channel %||% "", `Addition at` = sprintf("%g s", r$t_add_s),
             Baseline = sprintf("%.4g %s", r$baseline * x$scale, u), `Final level` = sprintf("%.4g %s", r$final * x$scale, u),
             Change = sprintf("%.4g %s", r$change * x$scale, u), t90 = sprintf("%.3g s", r$t90_s), t95 = sprintf("%.3g s", r$t95_s), check.names = FALSE) })
output$pq_table = renderTable(pq_tab())
output$pq_csv = downloadHandler("speed.csv", function(f) utils::write.csv(cbind(file = pq_x()$file, pq_res()), f, row.names = FALSE))

# Precision
pp_res = reactive(perf_try(function() perf_precision(perf_read("pp_file"))))
pp_plot_obj = reactive({ d = perf_cols(perf_read("pp_file")); d$value = perf_num(d$value); d = d[!is.na(d$value), , drop = FALSE]
  x = if ("day" %in% names(d)) "day" else NULL; col = if ("electrode" %in% names(d)) "electrode" else NULL
  d$xv = if (is.null(x)) "All" else as.character(d[[x]]); d$cv = if (is.null(col)) "All" else as.character(d[[col]])
  g = ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(xv, value, colour = cv)) + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = mean(d$value), colour = "grey60") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1), size = 2.2) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = if (is.null(x)) NULL else "Day", y = sprintf("Value (%s)", input$pp_sunit), colour = if (is.null(col)) NULL else "Electrode") + g_theme()
  if (is.null(col)) g + ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = perf_col, guide = "none") else g + ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal(length(unique(d$cv)))) })
output$pp_plot = renderPlot(pp_plot_obj())
pp_tab = reactive({ r = pp_res(); d = r$components; names(d)[2:3] = c(sprintf("SD (%s)", input$pp_sunit), "RSD (%)"); round_df(d) })
output$pp_table = renderTable(pp_tab())
output$pp_notes = renderUI({ r = pp_res(); helpText(sprintf("%d values, mean %.4g %s.", r$n, r$mean, input$pp_sunit), if (length(r$notes)) tags$ul(lapply(r$notes, tags$li))) })
output$pp_csv = downloadHandler("precision.csv", function(f) utils::write.csv(pp_res()$components, f, row.names = FALSE))

# Report sections: one per entry with data
performance_parts = function() Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  tp_section("Sensitivity", NULL, list(Calibration = ps_plot_obj), list(Results = ps_tab)),
  tp_section("Selectivity", function() sprintf("Change of the target signal with each interferent added (Thévenot et al., Pure Appl. Chem. 1999, 71, 2333, second procedure). Tolerated change ±%g%%.", input$pl_tol),
             list(`Change of the target signal` = pl_plot_obj), list(Interferents = pl_tab)),
  tp_section("Specificity", function() c("Response to each species alone at the target concentration (Thévenot et al., Pure Appl. Chem. 1999, 71, 2333, first procedure). It is given as a percentage of the target response (cross-reactivity) and as the ratio of the target signal to that of the species.",
                                          "Note: IUPAC recommends the term selectivity, which can be graded, and discourages specificity for the same concept. A method is either specific or not, and few methods, if any, are specific (Vessman et al., Pure Appl. Chem. 2001, 73, 1381)."),
             list(`Cross-reactivity` = pc_plot_obj), list(Species = pc_tab)),
  tp_section("Stability", NULL, list(Retention = pt_plot_obj), list(Summary = pt_tab, Points = function() round_df(pt_res()$points))),
  tp_section("Speed", NULL, list(Response = pq_plot_obj), list(Results = pq_tab)),
  tp_section("Precision", function() c(sprintf("%d values, mean %.4g %s.", pp_res()$n, pp_res()$mean, input$pp_sunit), pp_res()$notes),
             list(Values = pp_plot_obj), list(Components = pp_tab))))

name: report/electrofast_report.Rmd
content:
--- title: "`r params$title`" author: "`r params$author`" date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y, %H:%M')`" output: html_document: toc: true toc_float: true self_contained: true params: parts: NULL title: "ElectroFast analysis report" author: "" --- ```{r setup, include = FALSE} knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4.8, dpi = 120) P = params$parts tab = function(d, digits = 4) { if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(invisible(NULL)) d[] = lapply(d, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) signif(v, digits + 1) else v) if (exists("nice_names")) names(d) = nice_names(names(d)) knitr::kable(d, row.names = FALSE) } pm = function(m, s, d = 2) if (is.na(s)) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), m) else sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f ± %.", d, "f"), m, s) ``` This report covers every tab of ElectroFast that had data loaded when it was made. Tabs without data are left out. ## Settings ```{r} s = P$settings tab(data.frame(Setting = names(s), Value = vapply(s, function(v) paste(v, collapse = ", "), ""))) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$ecsa)} cat("## ECSA\n\n") r = P$ecsa$table cat(sprintf("The electrochemically active surface area is %.4f cm² (charge %.2f µC, roughness factor %.2f).\n\n", r[["ECSA (cm²)"]], r[["Q (µC)"]], r[["Roughness factor"]])) ``` ```{r, eval = !is.null(P$ecsa)} print(P$ecsa$plot) tab(P$ecsa$table) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$cal)} cat("## ISE calibration\n\n") s = P$cal$res$summary cat(sprintf("Over %d day(s), the slope over the fitted standards (%s) was %s mV/decade, %.1f%% of the Nernstian %.2f. R² ranged from %.4f to %.4f.\n\n", s$days, s$range, pm(s$slope_mean, s$slope_sd), s$pct_nernst, P$cal$res$S, s$r2_min, s$r2_max)) if (!is.null(P$cal$bg)) { b = P$cal$bg$summary cat(sprintf("The background-corrected fit to all standards gave %s mV/decade (%.1f%% of Nernstian), with an effective background of %.2g M.\n\n", pm(b$slope_mean, b$slope_sd), b$pct_nernst, b$b_bkg_mean)) } cat("### Calibration plot\n\n") ``` ```{r, eval = !is.null(P$cal)} print(P$cal$plot) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$cal)} cat("### Each day\n\n") print(tab(P$cal$res$per_day[, c("day", "n", "from_M", "to_M", "slope_mV_dec", "intercept_mV", "r2", "pct_nernst")])) if (!is.null(P$cal$cmp)) { c2 = P$cal$cmp$summary cat(sprintf("\n\nSecond range: %s mV/decade (%.1f%% of Nernstian), R² %.4f to %.4f.\n\n", pm(c2$slope_mean, c2$slope_sd), c2$pct_nernst, c2$r2_min, c2$r2_max)) } if (!is.null(P$cal$bg)) { cat("\n\n### Background-corrected fit, each day\n\n"); print(tab(P$cal$bg$per_day)) } cat("\n\n### Steps between neighbouring standards\n\n") print(tab(P$cal$steps)) cat("\n\n### Files used\n\n") print(tab(P$cal$std[, intersect(c("file", "day", "letter", "conc_M", "include", "note"), names(P$cal$std))])) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$rt)} cat("## Reading time\n\n") g = P$rt$suggest if (!is.null(g)) cat(if (is.na(g$read_s)) sprintf("No reading time reached the chosen share of settled standards (best %.0f%%).\n\n", 100 * g$share_settled) else sprintf("The suggested reading time is %d s, by which %.0f%% of the %d fitted standards had settled.\n\n", as.integer(g$read_s), 100 * g$share_settled, g$fitted_standards)) sp = P$rt$slopes$spread if (!is.null(sp)) { cat(sprintf("From %d s on, the slope changed by at most %.2f mV/decade on any day.", as.integer(P$rt$slopes$from_s), max(sp$spread_mV_dec))) fl = sp$day[sp$flagged] cat(if (length(fl)) sprintf(" Days changing by more than %g mV/decade: %s.\n\n", P$rt$slopes$flag_mV, paste(fl, collapse = ", ")) else " No day was flagged.\n\n") } ``` ```{r, eval = !is.null(P$rt)} print(P$rt$plot) tab(P$rt$slopes$spread) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$prec)} cat("## Precision\n\n") if (length(P$prec$notes)) cat(paste0("- ", P$prec$notes, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n") m = P$prec$chk$metrics if (!is.null(m)) print(tab(data.frame(Metric = m$metric, `SD (mV)` = round(m$SD_mV, 2), `Equivalent concentration error (%)` = round(m$conc_error_pct, 1), check.names = FALSE))) t = P$prec$cal$table if (!is.null(t)) { cat("\n\n### Calibration across days\n\n"); print(tab(t)) } ``` ```{r, eval = !is.null(P$prec) && !is.null(P$prec$plot)} print(P$prec$plot) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$fim)} cat("## Selectivity: fixed interference method\n\n") s = P$fim$res$summary cat(sprintf("With the interferent fixed at %g M, log K = %s over %d day(s) (K = %s).\n\n", P$fim$cB, pm(s$lgK_mean, s$lgK_sd), s$days, pm(s$K_mean, s$K_sd, 3))) ``` ```{r, eval = !is.null(P$fim)} print(P$fim$plot) tab(P$fim$res$per_day) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$ssm)} cat("## Selectivity: separate solution method\n\n") cat("Values are apparent when the primary and interfering ions do not both give Nernstian, parallel responses.\n\n") print(tab(P$ssm[, intersect(c("conc_M", "interferent_day", "E_primary_mean", "E_interferent", "lgK", "K"), names(P$ssm))])) ``` ```{r, results = "asis", eval = length(P$techniques) > 0} for (sec in P$techniques) { cat(" ## ", sec$title, " ", sep = "") if (length(sec$text)) cat(paste0("- ", sec$text, collapse = " "), " ") for (n in names(sec$plots)) { cat("### ", n, " ", sep = ""); print(sec$plots[[n]]); cat(" ") } for (n in names(sec$tables)) { cat("### ", n, " ", sep = ""); print(tab(sec$tables[[n]])); cat(" ") } } ``` ## Methods and references - ISE calibration: least-squares fit of EMF against −log a (Davies activities) or −log c, day by day. - Background-corrected fit: E = E0 + S log(x + b) (Dagar et al., Sens. Actuators B 2026, 468, 140650). - Selectivity: IUPAC fixed interference and separate solution methods (Umezawa et al., Pure Appl. Chem. 2000, 72, 1851). - Precision: linear mixed model with day as a random effect (Carnoli et al., Anal. Chim. Acta 2024, 1304, 342444). - ECSA: gold oxide reduction charge with 390 µC/cm² (Trasatti and Petrii, 1991). - Techniques: the equations and their sources are listed in the app's Equations tab.
